stories.title: 一个很高的人
stories.author: Cornelius Gulere

pages.zh: 他的锄头太短了。
pages.pinyin: tā de chútou tài duǎn le。
pages.en: His hoe was too short.

pages.zh: 他的门口太低了。
pages.pinyin: tā de ménkǒu tài dī le。
pages.en: His doorway was too low.

pages.zh: 他的床太短了。
pages.pinyin: tā de chuáng tài duǎn le。
pages.en: His bed was too short.

pages.zh: 他的自行车太短了。
pages.pinyin: tā de zìxíngchē tài duǎn le。
pages.en: His bicycle was too short.

pages.zh: 这个人太高了！
pages.pinyin: zhège rén tài gāo le！
pages.en: This man was too tall!

pages.zh: 他做了一个很长的锄柄。
pages.pinyin: tā zuò le yígè hěn zhǎng de chú bǐng。
pages.en: He made a very long hoe handle.

pages.zh: 他做了一个很高的门框。
pages.pinyin: tā zuò le yígè hěn gāo de mén kuāng。
pages.en: He made very high door frames.

pages.zh: 他做了一张很长的床。
pages.pinyin: tā zuò le yī zhāng hěn zhǎng de chuáng。
pages.en: He made a very long bed.

pages.zh: 他买了一辆很高的自行车。
pages.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī liàng hěn gāo de zìxíngchē。
pages.en: He bought a very high bicycle.

pages.zh: 他坐在一把很高的椅子上。他用一把很长的叉子吃饭。
pages.pinyin: tā zuò zài yī bǎ hěn gāo de yǐzi shàng。 tā yòng yī bǎ hěn zhǎng de chāzi chī fàn。
pages.en: He sat on a very high chair. He ate with a very long fork.

pages.zh: 他离开他的房子住进一个很大的森林里。他在那里住了很多年。
pages.pinyin: tā líkāi tā de fángzi zhù jìn yígè hěn dà de sēnlín lǐ。 tā zài nàlǐ zhù le hěn duō nián。
pages.en: He left his house and lived in a big forest. He lived for many years.

stories.title: 山羊、野狗、和水牛
stories.title_pinyin: shānyáng、 yě gǒu、 hé shuǐ niú
stories.author: Fabian Wakholi

pages.zh: 山羊、野狗、和水牛是很要好的朋友。有一天，他们一起坐出租车。
pages.pinyin: shānyáng、 yě gǒu、 hé shuǐ niú shì hěn yàohǎo de péngyǒu。 yǒuyītiān， tāmen yìqǐ zuò chūzūchē。
pages.en:
Goat, Dog, and Cow
were great friends. One
day they went on a
journey in a taxi.

pages.zh: 当他们到了目的地的时候，司机叫他们交车费。水牛把她自己的那份交了。
pages.pinyin: dāng tāmen dàole mùdìdì de shíhòu， sījī jiào tāmen jiāo chēfèi。 shuǐ niú bǎ tā zìjǐ de nà fèn jiāo le。
pages.en:
When they reached the
end of their journey, the
driver asked them to
pay their fares. Cow
paid her fare.

pages.zh: 野狗没有带零钱，所以他就多给了一点儿。
pages.pinyin: yě gǒu méiyǒu dài língqián， suǒyǐ tā jiù duō gěi le yìdiǎnér。
pages.en:
Dog paid a bit extra,
because he did not
have the correct money.

pages.zh: 司机正要找钱给野狗，没想到山羊没有给钱就跑掉了。
pages.pinyin: sījī zhèngyào zhǎo qián gěi yě gǒu， méi xiǎng dào shānyáng méiyǒu gěiqián jiù pǎo diào le。
pages.en:
The driver was about to
give Dog his change
when Goat ran away
without paying
anything.

pages.zh: 司机很生气，结果他没有给野狗找钱就开走了。
pages.pinyin: sījī hěn shēngqì， jiéguǒ tā méiyǒu gěi yě gǒu zhǎo qián jiù kāi zǒu le。
pages.en:
The driver was very
annoyed. He drove
away without giving
Dog his change.

pages.zh: 所以，现在你可以看到野狗看到车子就拼命追上去，因为他想叫司机给他找钱。
pages.pinyin: suǒyǐ， xiànzài nǐ kěyǐ kàn dào yě gǒu kàn dào chēzi jiù pīnmìng zhuī shàngqù， yīnwèi tā xiǎng jiào sījī gěi tā zhǎo qián。
pages.en:
That is why, even
today, Dog runs
towards a car to peep
inside and find the
driver who owes him his
change.

pages.zh: 山羊呢，一听到有车来就吓得赶快逃走，因为她怕没交车费被人抓起来。
pages.pinyin: shānyáng ne， yī tīng dào yǒu chē lái jiù xià dé gǎnkuài táo zǒu， yīnwèi tā pà méi jiāo chēfèi bèi rén zhuā qǐlái。
pages.en:
Goat runs away from
the sound of a car. She
is afraid she will be
arrested for not paying
her fare.

pages.zh: 可是水牛听到车来一点儿都不急。她不慌不忙地过马路，因为她知道她已经把她自己那份交了。
pages.pinyin: kěshì shuǐ niú tīng dào chē lái yìdiǎnér dōu bù jí。 tā bùhuāngbùmáng dì guò mǎlù， yīnwèi tā zhīdào tā yǐjīng bǎ tā zìjǐ nà fèn jiāo le。
pages.en:
And Cow is not
bothered when a car is
coming. Cow takes her
time crossing the road
because she knows she
paid her fare in full.

stories.title: 阿南西和智慧
stories.author: Ghanaian folktale

pages.zh:
很久很久以前，人们什么都不知道。
他们不知道怎么耕田织布，也不知道怎么制造铁器。
天上的尼亚美神把世界所有的智慧都藏在一个砂锅里面。
pages.pinyin: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐqián， rénmen shénme dōu bù zhīdào。 tāmen bù zhīdào zěnme gēng tián zhībù， yě bù zhīdào zěnme zhìzào tiě qì。 tiānshàng de ní yà měi shén bǎ shìjiè suǒyǒu de zhìhuì dōu cáng zài yígè shā guō lǐmiàn。
pages.en:
Long long ago people didn’t
know anything. They didn’t
know how to plant crops, or
how to weave cloth, or how to
make iron tools.
The god Nyame up in the sky
had all the wisdom of the world.
He kept it safe in a clay pot.

pages.zh:
有一天，尼亚美决定把藏有智慧的砂锅交给蜘蛛神阿南西。
每当阿南西揭开砂锅往里看，他就会学到新的东西。他感到很兴奋！
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， ní yà měi juédìng bǎ cáng yǒu zhìhuì de shā guō jiāogěi zhī zhū shén ā nán xī。 měidāng ā nán xī jiēkāi shā guō wǎng lǐ kàn， tā jiù huì xué dào xīn de dōngxī。 tā gǎndào hěn xīngfèn！
pages.en:
One day, Nyame decided that
he would give the pot of
wisdom to Anansi.
Every time Anansi looked in the
clay pot, he learned something
new. It was so exciting!

pages.zh:
贪心的阿南西跟自己说，
“我把砂锅安放在树顶上，那样所有的智慧就都只属于我了！”
所以，他织出了一条长长的丝线，把砂锅牢牢地拴住，然后把丝线的另一端系在自己的肚子上。
他开始往那棵树上爬，
可是砂锅总是撞到他的腿，爬起来很辛苦。
pages.pinyin: tān xīn de ā nán xī gēn zìjǐ shuō， “wǒ bǎ shā guō ān fàng zài shù dǐngshàng， nàyàng suǒyǒu de zhìhuì jiù dōu zhǐ shǔyú wǒ le！” suǒyǐ， tā zhī chū le yītiáo chángcháng de sī xiàn， bǎ shā guō láoláo dì shuān zhù， ránhòu bǎ sī xiàn de lìng yī duān xì zài zìjǐ de dǔzi shàng。 tā kāishǐ wǎng nà kē shù shàng pá， kěshì shā guō zǒngshì zhuàng dào tā de tuǐ， pá qǐlái hěn xīnkǔ。
pages.en:
Greedy Anansi thought, “I’ll
keep the pot safe at the top of a
tall tree. Then I can have it all
to myself!”
He spun a long thread, wound it
round the clay pot, and tied it to
his stomach.
He began to climb the tree. But
it was hard climbing the tree
with the pot bumping him in the
knees all the time.

pages.zh:
阿南西的儿子在树底下看到了一切。
他跟阿南西说，“把砂锅扛在背上不就容易了吗？”
于是阿南西就试着把砂锅扛在背上，果然容易很多。
pages.pinyin: ā nán xī de érzi zài shù dǐxià kàn dàole yīqiè。 tā gēn ā nán xī shuō，“bǎ shā guō káng zài bèi shàng bù jiù róngyì le ma？” yúshì ā nán xī jiù shì zhe bǎ shā guō káng zài bèi shàng， guǒrán róngyì hěn duō。
pages.en:
All the time Anansi’s young son
had been standing at the
bottom of the tree watching. He
said, “Wouldn’t it be easier to
climb if you tied the pot to your
back instead?”
Anansi tried tying the clay pot
full of wisdom to his back, and it
really was a lot easier.

pages.zh:
阿南西很快就爬到树顶上。
可是他突然想到一个问题：
“拥有所有智慧的人应该是我，可是刚才我儿子居然比我还聪明！”
阿南西气得差点跳起来了，一气之下竟把砂锅扔到树下。
pages.pinyin: ā nán xī hěn kuài jiù pá dào shù dǐngshàng。 kěshì tā tūrán xiǎng dào yígè wèntí： “yōngyǒu suǒyǒu zhìhuì de rén yīnggāi shì wǒ， kěshì gāngcái wǒ érzi jūrán bǐ wǒ hái cōngmíng！” ā nán xī qì dé chàdiǎn tiàoqǐlái le， yíqìzhīxià jìng bǎ shā guō rēng dào shù xià。
pages.en:
In no time he reached the top of
the tree.
But then he stopped and
thought, “I’m supposed to be
the one with all the wisdom,
and here my son was cleverer
than me!”
Anansi was so angry about this
that he threw the clay pot down
out of the tree.

pages.zh:
砂锅一落地就碎成小片。
砂锅碎了，所有的智慧也跑了出来，大家可以自由分享了。
就是这样，世上的人们才学会如何耕田、如何织布，如何打铁做铁器，还有所有现在人会做的一切。
pages.pinyin: shā guō yī luòdì jiù suì chéng xiǎo piàn。 shā guō suì le， suǒyǒu de zhìhuì yě pǎo le chūlái， dàjiā kěyǐ zìyóu fēnxiǎng le。 jiùshì zhèyàng， shìshàng de rénmen cái xuéhuì rúhé gēng tián、 rúhé zhībù， rúhé dǎtiě zuò tiě qì， hái yǒu suǒyǒu xiànzài rén huì zuò de yīqiè。
pages.en:
It smashed into pieces on the
ground. The wisdom was free
for everyone to share.
And that is how people learned
to farm, to weave cloth, to
make iron tools, and all the
other things that people know
how to do.

stories.title: 你在做什么？
stories.author: Nina Orange

pages.zh: 我在唱歌。
pages.pinyin: wǒ zài chàng gē。
pages.en: I am singing.

pages.zh: 她在挥手。
pages.pinyin: tā zài huī shǒu。
pages.en: She is waving.

pages.zh: 我在拍手。
pages.pinyin: wǒ zài pāi shǒu。
pages.en: I am clapping.

pages.zh: 她在伸手。
pages.pinyin: tā zài shēnshǒu。
pages.en: She is stretching.

pages.zh: 他在叫喊。
pages.pinyin: tā zài jiào hǎn。
pages.en: He is calling.

pages.zh: 我在回答。
pages.pinyin: wǒ zài huídá。
pages.en: I am answering.

pages.zh: 她在聆听。
pages.pinyin: tā zài líng tīng。
pages.en: She is listening.

pages.zh: 你在做什么？
pages.pinyin: nǐ zài zuò shénme？
pages.en: What are you doing?

stories.title: 决定
stories.author: Ursula Nafula

pages.zh: 我的村庄面临很多问题。村里只有一个水龙头，我们每天都要排很长的队伍去接水。
pages.pinyin: wǒ de cūnzhuāng miànlín hěn duō wèntí。 cūn lǐ zhǐyǒu yígè shuǐlóngtóu， wǒmen měi tiān dōu yào pái hěn zhǎng de duìwǔ qù jiē shuǐ。
pages.en:
My village had many problems.
We made a long line to fetch water from one tap.

pages.zh: 我们等着别人接济食物给我们吃。
pages.pinyin: wǒmen děng zhe biérén jiējì shíwù gěi wǒmen chī。
pages.en: We waited for food donated by others.

pages.zh: 每天晚上，我们因为害怕有小偷，所以都早早地锁上了门。
pages.pinyin: měi tiān wǎnshàng， wǒmen yīnwèi hàipà yǒu xiǎo tōu， suǒyǐ dōu zǎo zǎo dì suǒshàng le mén。
pages.en: We locked our houses early because of thieves.

pages.zh: 中途辍学的孩子也不少。
pages.pinyin: zhōngtú chuò xué de háizi yě bùshǎo。
pages.en: Many children dropped out of school.

pages.zh: 年轻的女孩被迫到别的村庄去做女佣。
pages.pinyin: niánqīng de nǚhái bèipò dào biéde cūnzhuāng qù zuò nǚ yōng。
pages.en: Young girls worked as maids in other villages.

pages.zh: 年轻的男孩不是成天在村子里游荡，就是到别人的农场里打工。
pages.pinyin: niánqīng de nán hái búshì chéngtiān zài cūn zi lǐ yóu dàng， jiùshì dào biérén de nóngchǎng lǐ dǎgōng。
pages.en: Young boys roamed around the village while others worked on people’s farms.

pages.zh: 起风的时候，废纸到处乱飞，挂在树梢和篱笆上。
pages.pinyin: qǐfēng de shíhòu， fèi zhǐ dàochù luàn fēi， guà zài shùshāo hé lí bā shàng。
pages.en: When the wind blew, waste paper hung on trees and fences.

pages.zh: 碎玻璃扔得到处都是，很多人都被碎玻璃划伤了。
pages.pinyin: suì bōlí rēng dédào chù dōu shì， hěn duō rén dōu bèi suì bōlí huà shāng le。
pages.en: People were cut by broken glass that was thrown carelessly.

pages.zh: 终于有一天，水龙头干涸了，人们接不到水了。
pages.pinyin: zhōngyú yǒuyītiān， shuǐlóngtóu gānhé le， rénmen jiē búdào shuǐ le。
pages.en: Then one day, the tap dried up and our containers were empty.

pages.zh: 我的爸爸一家一家地劝说，召集村里的居民们开会。
pages.pinyin: wǒ de bàbà yījiā yījiā dì quànshuō， zhàojí cūn lǐ de jūmín men kāihuì。
pages.en: My father walked from house to house asking people to attend a village meeting.

pages.zh: 人们聚到一棵大树下，准备开会。
pages.pinyin: rénmen jù dào yī kē dàshù xià， zhǔnbèi kāihuì。
pages.en: People gathered under a big tree and listened.

pages.zh: 我爸爸站起来，说：“我们必须团结起来，一起解决我们的问题。”
pages.pinyin: wǒ bàbà zhànqǐlái， shuō：“wǒmen bìxū tuánjié qǐlái， yìqǐ jiějué wǒmende wèntí。”
pages.en: My father stood up and said, “We need to work together to solve our problems.”

pages.zh: 八岁的珠玛坐在树干上，大声说：“我可以帮忙清理村庄。”
pages.pinyin: bā suì de zhū mǎ zuò zài shùgàn shàng， dàshēng shuō：“wǒ kěyǐ bāngmáng qīnglǐ cūnzhuāng。”
pages.en: Eight-year-old Juma, sitting on a tree trunk shouted, “I can help with cleaning up.”

pages.zh: 一个女人站起来说：“我可以找一些妇女，一起种庄稼。”
pages.pinyin: yígè nǚrén zhànqǐlái shuō：“wǒ kěyǐ zhǎo yīxiē fùnǚ， yìqǐ zhǒng zhuāngjià。”
pages.en: One woman said, “The women can join me to grow food.”

pages.zh: 又有一个男人站起来说：“男人们可以帮着打井。”
pages.pinyin: yòu yǒu yígè nánrén zhànqǐlái shuō：“nánrén men kěyǐ bāng zhe dǎ jǐng。”
pages.en: Another man stood up and said, “The men will dig a well.”

pages.zh: 我们异口同声地说：“我们必须改变我们的生活。”从那天开始，大伙儿都齐心协力，解决问题。
pages.pinyin: wǒmen yìkǒutóngshēng dì shuō：“wǒmen bìxū gǎibiàn wǒmende shēnghuó。” cóng nà tiān kāishǐ， dàhuǒér dōu qíxīnxiélì， jiějué wèntí。
pages.en:
We all shouted with one voice, “We must change our lives.”
From that day we worked together to solve our problems.

stories.title: 辛波薇亚
stories.author: Rukia Nantale

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚的妈妈过世的时候，她非常伤心。辛波薇亚的爸爸尽全力照顾孩子。时间久了，他们渐渐开心起来，习惯了没有辛波薇亚妈妈的生活。每天早上，他们坐在一起，谈论着即将到来的一天。每天晚上，他们一起做饭，然后一起洗碗，辛波薇亚的爸爸还帮助她做功课。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà de māmā guòshì de shíhòu， tā fēicháng shāngxīn。 xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà jìnquánlì zhàogù háizi。 shíjiān jiǔ le， tāmen jiànjiàn kāixīn qǐlái， xíguàn le méiyǒu xīn bō wēi yà māmā de shēnghuó。 měi tiān zǎoshàng， tāmen zuò zài yìqǐ， tánlùn zhe jíjiāng dàolái de yī tiān。 měi tiān wǎnshàng， tāmen yìqǐ zuòfàn， ránhòu yìqǐ xǐ wǎn， xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà hái bāngzhù tā zuò gōngkè。
pages.en:
When Simbegwire’s mother died,
she was very sad. Simbegwire’s
father did his best to take care of
his daughter. Slowly, they learned
to feel happy again, without
Simbegwire’s mother.
Every morning they sat and talked
about the day ahead. Every evening
they made dinner together. After
they washed the dishes,
Simbegwire’s father helped her with
homework.

pages.zh: 有一天，辛波薇亚的爸爸回家晚了。他一进门就喊道：“亲爱的孩子，你在哪里？”辛波薇亚跑出来迎接爸爸。但她突然停住了，因为她看到爸爸牵着另外一个女人的手。爸爸笑着说：“我的孩子，来，我向你介绍一个很特别的人，她叫阿妮塔。”
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà huí jiā wǎn le。 tā yī jìn mén jiù hǎn dào：“qīnài de háizi， nǐ zài nǎlǐ？” xīn bō wēi yà pǎo chūlái yíngjiē bàbà。 dàn tā tūrán tíng zhù le， yīnwèi tā kàn dào bàbà qiān zhe lìngwài yígè nǚrén de shǒu。 bàbà xiào zhe shuō：“wǒ de háizi， lái， wǒ xiàng nǐ jièshào yígè hěn tèbié de rén， tā jiào ā nī tǎ。”
pages.en:
One day, Simbegwire’s father came
home later than usual. “Where are
you my child?” he called.
Simbegwire ran to her father. She
stopped still when she saw that he
was holding a woman’s hand. “I
want you to meet someone special,
my child. This is Anita,” he said
smiling.

pages.zh: 阿妮塔跟辛波薇亚打招呼：“你好，辛波薇亚！你的爸爸跟我说了很多关于你的事。”她没有朝辛波薇亚微笑，也没有牵她的手。辛波薇亚的爸爸很高兴，他兴奋地说着，如果他们三个人住在一起，一定会很幸福的。爸爸朝辛波薇亚说：“我的孩子，我希望你能接受阿妮塔成为你的母亲。”
pages.pinyin: ā nī tǎ gēn xīn bō wēi yà dǎzhāohū：“nǐhǎo， xīn bō wēi yà！ nǐ de bàbà gēn wǒ shuō le hěn duō guānyú nǐ de shì。” tā méiyǒu cháo xīn bō wēi yà wēixiào， yě méiyǒu qiān tā de shǒu。 xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà hěn gāoxìng， tā xīngfèn dì shuō zhe， rúguǒ tāmen sān gèrén zhù zài yìqǐ， yídìng huì hěn xìngfú de。 bàbà cháo xīn bō wēi yà shuō：“wǒ de háizi， wǒ xīwàng nǐ néng jiēshòu ā nī tǎ chéngwéi nǐ de mǔqīn。”
pages.en:
“Hello Simbegwire, your father told
me a lot about you,” said Anita. But
she did not smile or take the girl’s
hand.
Simbegwire’s father was happy and
excited. He talked about the three
of them living together, and how
good their life would be. “My child, I
hope you will accept Anita as your
mother,” he said.

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚的生活变了。她每天早上没有时间和爸爸坐在一起聊天。阿妮塔让辛波薇亚做很多家务，辛波薇亚每天晚上都累极了，根本没有时间做功课。她一吃完晚饭就睡觉了。她唯一的安慰就是妈妈留给她的彩色毯子。辛波薇亚的爸爸似乎没有意识到女儿一点儿也不开心。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà de shēnghuó biàn le。 tā měi tiān zǎoshàng méiyǒu shíjiān hé bàbà zuò zài yìqǐ liáo tiān。 ā nī tǎ ràng xīn bō wēi yà zuò hěn duō jiāwù， xīn bō wēi yà měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu lèi jí le， gēnběn méiyǒu shíjiān zuò gōngkè。 tā yī chī wán wǎnfàn jiù shuìjiào le。 tā wéiyī de ānwèi jiùshì māmā liú gěi tā de cǎisè tǎnzi。 xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà sìhū méiyǒu yìshí dào nǚér yìdiǎnér yě bù kāixīn。
pages.en:
Simbegwire’s life changed. She no
longer had time to sit with her
father in the mornings. Anita gave
her so many household chores that
she was too tired to do her school
work in the evenings. She went
straight to bed after dinner.
Her only comfort was the colourful
blanket her mother gave her.
Simbegwire’s father did not seem to
notice that his daughter was
unhappy.

pages.zh: 过了几个月，辛波薇亚的爸爸告诉她们，他要离家一段时间。他说：“我得出差，我相信你们会互相照顾对方的。”辛波薇亚低下头，但她的爸爸没有注意。阿妮塔什么也没说，她也不太高兴。
pages.pinyin: guò le jǐgè yuè， xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà gàosù tāmen， tā yào líjiā yī duàn shíjiān。 tā shuō：“wǒ dé chūchāi， wǒ xiāngxìn nǐmen huì hùxiāng zhàogù duìfāng de。” xīn bō wēi yà dīxià tou， dàn tā de bàbà méiyǒu zhùyì。 ā nī tǎ shénme yě méi shuō， tā yě bù tài gāoxìng。
pages.en:
After a few months, Simbegwire’s
father told them that he would be
away from home for a while. “I have
to travel for my job,” he said. “But I
know you will look after each other.”
Simbegwire’s face fell, but her
father did not notice. Anita did not
say anything. She was not happy
either.

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚的生活变得更糟糕了。如果辛波薇亚没有做完家务，或者她稍微有点抱怨的话，阿妮塔就会打她。晚上，阿妮塔把大多数食物都吃了，只留给辛波薇亚一点剩饭剩菜。每天晚上，辛波薇亚都流着泪入睡，她只能紧紧地抱着妈妈留下的毯子。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà de shēnghuó biàn dé gèng zāogāo le。 rúguǒ xīn bō wēi yà méiyǒu zuò wán jiāwù， huòzhě tā shāowēi yǒudiǎn bàoyuàn dehuà， ā nī tǎ jiù huì dǎ tā。 wǎnshàng， ā nī tǎ bǎ dàduōshù shíwù dōu chī le， zhǐ liú gěi xīn bō wēi yà yìdiǎn shèng fàn shèng cài。 měi tiān wǎnshàng， xīn bō wēi yà dōu liú zhe lèi rù shuì， tā zhǐnéng jǐn jǐn dì bào zhe māmā liúxià de tǎnzi。
pages.en:
Things got worse for Simbegwire. If
she didn’t finish her chores, or she
complained, Anita hit her. And at
dinner, the woman ate most of the
food, leaving Simbegwire with only
a few scraps.
Each night Simbegwire cried herself
to sleep, hugging her mother’s
blanket.

pages.zh: 一天早上，辛波薇亚起床晚了。阿妮塔气极了：“你这个懒虫！”她把辛波薇亚从床上拉起来。毯子勾到一颗钉子，撕成了两半。
pages.pinyin: yī tiān zǎoshàng， xīn bō wēi yà qǐchuáng wǎn le。 ā nī tǎ qì jí le：“nǐ zhège lǎn chóng！” tā bǎ xīn bō wēi yà cóng chuáng shàng lā qǐlái。 tǎnzi gōu dào yī kē dīngzi， sī chéng le liǎng bàn。
pages.en:
One morning, Simbegwire was late
getting out of bed. “You lazy girl!”
Anita shouted. She pulled
Simbegwire out of bed. The
precious blanket caught on a nail,
and tore in two.

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚伤心透了，她决定离家出走。她带着毯子的碎片，包了一些食物，沿着爸爸出差的路离开了家里。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà shāngxīn tòu le， tā juédìng líjiā chūzǒu。 tā dài zhe tǎnzi de suìpiàn， bāo le yīxiē shíwù， yánzhe bàbà chūchāi de lù líkāi le jiālǐ。
pages.en:
Simbegwire was very upset. She
decided to run away from home.
She took the pieces of her mother’s
blanket, packed some food, and left
the house. She followed the road
her father had taken.

pages.zh: 天黑了，辛波薇亚找到一棵长在小溪旁边的树。她爬上了树，在树枝上搭了一张小床。她唱着歌，渐渐睡着了：“妈妈，妈妈，妈妈，你离开了我，离开了我再也不回来了。爸爸再也不爱我了。妈妈，你什么时候回来，你离开了我……”
pages.pinyin: tiān hēi le， xīn bō wēi yà zhǎo dào yī kē zhǎng zài xiǎo xī pángbiān de shù。 tā pá shàng le shù， zài shùzhī shàng dā le yī zhāng xiǎo chuáng。 tā chàng zhe gē， jiànjiàn shuìzháo le：“māmā， māmā， māmā， nǐ líkāi le wǒ， líkāi le wǒ zài yě bù huílái le。 bàbà zài yě bù ài wǒ le。 māmā， nǐ shénmeshíhòu huílái， nǐ líkāi le wǒ……”
pages.en:
When it came to evening, she
climbed a tall tree near a stream
and made a bed for herself in the
branches.
As she went to sleep, she sang:
“Maama, maama, maama, you left
me.
You left me and never came back.
Father doesn’t love me anymore.
Mother, when are you coming back?
You left me.”

pages.zh: 第二天早上，辛波薇亚又唱起了这首歌。附近的女人到溪水边来洗衣服，她们听到了树上传来的歌声。她们以为这是风穿过树叶的声音，于是就没有在意，继续洗衣服。但其中有个女人仔细地听着这首歌。
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān zǎoshàng， xīn bō wēi yà yòu chàng qǐ le zhè shǒu gē。 fùjìn de nǚrén dào xīshuǐ biān lái xǐyīfú， tāmen tīng dàole shù shàng chuán lái de gēshēng。 tāmen yǐwéi zhè shì fēng chuānguò shùyè de shēngyīn， yúshì jiù méiyǒu zàiyì， jìxù xǐyīfú。 dàn qízhōng yǒu gè nǚrén zǐxì dì tīng zhe zhè shǒu gē。
pages.en:
The next morning, Simbegwire sang
the song again. When the women
came to wash their clothes at the
stream, they heard the sad song
coming from the tall tree.
They thought it was only the wind
rustling the leaves, and carried on
with their work. But one of the
women listened very carefully to
the song.

pages.zh: 女人抬起头来看着那棵树。当她看到辛波薇亚和那条彩色的毯子时，她吓了一跳：“辛波薇亚，我哥哥的孩子！”其他的女人也停下了手里的活儿，帮助辛波薇亚从树上爬了下来。她的姑姑紧紧地抱着她，尽量安慰她。
pages.pinyin: nǚrén tái qǐtóu lái kàn zhe nà kē shù。 dāng tā kàn dào xīn bō wēi yà hé nà tiáo cǎisè de tǎnzi shí， tā xià le yī tiào：“xīn bō wēi yà， wǒ gēgē de háizi！” qítā de nǚrén yě tíng xià le shǒu lǐ de huóer， bāngzhù xīn bō wēi yà cóng shù shàng pá le xiàlái。 tā de gūgū jǐn jǐn dì bào zhe tā， jǐnliàng ānwèi tā。
pages.en:
This woman looked up into the tree.
When she saw the girl and the
pieces of colourful blanket, she
cried, “Simbegwire, my brother’s
child!”
The other women stopped washing
and helped Simbegwire to climb
down from the tree. Her aunt
hugged the little girl and tried to
comfort her.

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚的姑姑带着她去了自己家。她给辛波薇亚煮了美味的食物，又给她铺了床，让她盖着妈妈的毯子睡觉。那天晚上，辛波薇亚又哭着睡着了。不过这次是欣慰的泪水。她知道她的姑姑会照顾她。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà de gūgū dài zhe tā qù le zìjǐ jiā。 tā gěi xīn bō wēi yà zhǔ le měiwèi de shíwù， yòu gěi tā pù le chuáng， ràng tā gài zhe māmā de tǎnzi shuìjiào。 nà tiān wǎnshàng， xīn bō wēi yà yòu kū zhe shuìzháo le。 bùguò zhècì shì xīnwèi de lèishuǐ。 tā zhīdào tā de gūgū huì zhàogù tā。
pages.en:
Simbegwire’s aunt took the child to
her own house. She gave
Simbegwire warm food, and tucked
her in bed with her mother’s
blanket.
That night, Simbegwire cried as she
went to sleep. But they were tears
of relief. She knew her aunt would
look after her.

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚的爸爸回到家里，发现辛波薇亚的房间里空荡荡的。他疲倦极了，问阿妮塔发生了什么事。阿妮塔说辛波薇亚离家出走了。她解释道：“我只是想让她尊敬我，但是我可能太严格了。”辛波薇亚的爸爸跑出家门，沿着小溪去找辛波薇亚。他走到了妹妹的村庄，想问问她有没有见过辛波薇亚。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà huí dàojiā lǐ， fāxiàn xīn bō wēi yà de fángjiān lǐ kōngdàngdàng de。 tā píjuàn jí le， wèn ā nī tǎ fāshēng le shénmeshì。 ā nī tǎ shuō xīn bō wēi yà líjiā chūzǒu le。 tā jiěshì dào：“wǒ zhǐshì xiǎng ràng tā zūnjìng wǒ， dànshì wǒ kěnéng tài yángé le。” xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà pǎo chūjiā mén， yánzhe xiǎo xī qù zhǎo xīn bō wēi yà。 tā zǒu dàole mèimèi de cūnzhuāng， xiǎng wèn wèn tā yǒu méiyǒu jiàn guò xīn bō wēi yà。
pages.en:
When Simbegwire’s father returned
home, he found her room empty.
“What happened, Anita?” he asked
with a heavy heart. The woman
explained that Simbegwire had run
away. “I wanted her to respect me,”
she said. “But perhaps I was too
strict.”
Simbegwire’s father left the house
and went in the direction of the
stream. He continued to his sister’s
village to find out if she had seen
Simbegwire.

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚正在和她的表兄弟姐妹玩耍，但她突然看到了远处的爸爸。她害怕爸爸会生气，于是就跑到房子里躲了起来。但是爸爸找到她，对她说：“辛波薇亚，你自己找到了一个完美的妈妈，她爱你，理解你。我为你感到骄傲，我爱你。”他们商量后决定辛波薇亚可以和姑姑住在一起，想呆多久就可以呆多久。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà zhèngzài hé tā de biǎoxiōngdì jiěmèi wánshuǎ， dàn tā tūrán kàn dàole yuǎnchù de bàbà。 tā hàipà bàbà huì shēngqì， yúshì jiù pǎo dào fángzi lǐ duǒ le qǐlái。 dànshì bàbà zhǎo dào tā， duì tā shuō：“xīn bō wēi yà， nǐ zìjǐ zhǎo dàole yígè wánměi de māmā， tā ài nǐ， lǐjiě nǐ。 wǒ wèi nǐ gǎndào jiāoào， wǒ ài nǐ。” tāmen shāngliáng hòu juédìng xīn bō wēi yà kěyǐ hé gūgū zhù zài yìqǐ， xiǎng dāi duō jiǔ jiù kěyǐ dāi duō jiǔ。
pages.en:
Simbegwire was playing with her
cousins when she saw her father
from far away. She was scared he
might be angry, so she ran inside
the house to hide.
But her father went to her and said,
“Simbegwire, you have found a
perfect mother for yourself. One
who loves you and understands
you. I am proud of you and I love
you.”
They agreed that Simbegwire would
stay with her aunt as long as she
wanted to.

pages.zh: 辛波薇亚的爸爸每天都来看她。有一天，他和阿妮塔一起来了。阿妮塔朝辛波薇亚伸出手，她哭了：“我太抱歉了，小家伙，对不起，我错了，你可以再给我一次机会吗？”辛波薇亚看了看爸爸，看到他忧虑的脸庞。她朝前走了一步，抱住了阿妮塔。
pages.pinyin: xīn bō wēi yà de bàbà měi tiān dōu lái kàn tā。 yǒuyītiān， tā hé ā nī tǎ yìqǐ lái le。 ā nī tǎ cháo xīn bō wēi yà shēn chūshǒu， tā kū le：“wǒ tài bàoqiàn le， xiǎojiāhuo， duìbùqǐ， wǒ cuò le， nǐ kěyǐ zài gěi wǒ yī cì jīhuì ma？” xīn bō wēi yà kàn le kàn bàbà， kàn dào tā yōulǜ de liǎn páng。 tā cháo qián zǒu le yī bù， bào zhù le ā nī tǎ。
pages.en:
Her father visited her every day.
Eventually, he came with Anita. She
reached out for Simbegwire’s hand.
“I’m so sorry little one, I was
wrong,” she cried. “Will you let me
try again?”
Simbegwire looked at her father
and his worried face. Then she
stepped forward slowly and put her
arms around Anita.

pages.zh: 过了几天，阿妮塔邀请辛波薇亚，姑姑和姑姑的孩子们一起到家里吃饭。好丰盛啊！而且那都是辛波薇亚喜欢吃的东西，每个人都吃得津津有味。吃完饭，大人们在家里聊天，孩子们在外面玩耍。辛波薇亚觉得很开心，自己变得更加勇敢了。她决定不久以后就要回到家里，和自己的爸爸，继母住在一起。
pages.pinyin: guò le jǐ tiān， ā nī tǎ yāoqǐng xīn bō wēi yà， gūgū hé gūgū de háizi men yìqǐ dàojiā lǐ chī fàn。 hǎo fēngshèng a！ érqiě nà dōu shì xīn bō wēi yà xǐhuān chī de dōngxī， měi gèrén dōu chī dé jīnjīnyǒuwèi。 chī wán fàn， dàrén men zàijiā lǐ liáo tiān， háizi men zài wàimiàn wánshuǎ。 xīn bō wēi yà juéde hěn kāixīn， zìjǐ biàn dé gèngjiā yǒnggǎn le。 tā juédìng bùjiǔ yǐhòu jiùyào huí dàojiā lǐ， hé zìjǐ de bàbà， jìmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ。
pages.en:
The next week, Anita invited
Simbegwire, with her cousins and
aunt, to the house for a meal. What
a feast! Anita prepared all of
Simbegwire’s favourite foods, and
everyone ate until they were full.
Then the children played while the
adults talked.
Simbegwire felt happy and brave.
She decided that soon, very soon,
she would return home to live with
her father and her stepmother.

pages.zh: 很久很久以前，有三个女孩，她们一起外出找柴火。
pages.pinyin: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐqián， yǒu sān gè nǚhái， tāmen yìqǐ wàichū zhǎo chái huǒ。
pages.en:
A long time ago, three girls went
out to collect wood.

pages.zh: 天很热，她们跳下河游了个泳。她们一边游泳，一边嬉戏，溅出很多水花。
pages.pinyin: tiān hěn rè， tāmen tiào xià hé yóu le gè yǒng。 tāmen yībiān yóuyǒng， yībiān xīxì， jiàn chū hěn duō shuǐ huā。
pages.en:
It was a hot day so they went down
to the river to swim.
They played and splashed and
swam in the water.

pages.zh: 突然，她们意识到天已经很晚了，匆匆忙忙赶回村子。
pages.pinyin: tūrán， tāmen yìshí dào tiān yǐjīng hěn wǎn le， cōngcōng máng máng gǎn huí cūn zi。
pages.en:
Suddenly, they realised that it was
late.
They hurried back to the village.

pages.zh: 当她们快到家的时候，诺孜贝儿摸了摸她的脖子：她把项链落在了外面。于是她请求她的朋友们：“和我一起回去找找吧！”但她的朋友们都说太晚了。
pages.pinyin: dāng tāmen kuài dàojiā de shíhòu， nuò zī bèi ér mō le mō tā de bózi： tā bǎ xiàngliàn luò zài le wàimiàn。 yúshì tā qǐngqiú tā de péngyǒu men：“hé wǒ yìqǐ huíqù zhǎo zhǎo ba！” dàn tā de péngyǒu men dōu shuō tài wǎn le。
pages.en:
When they were nearly home,
Nozibele put her hand to her neck.
She had forgotten her necklace!
“Please come back with me!” she
begged her friends.
But her friends said it was too late.

pages.zh: 诺孜贝儿一个人回到河边，一找到了项链，就赶忙回家，但天太黑了，她迷路了。
pages.pinyin: nuò zī bèi ér yígè rén huí dào hé biān， yī zhǎo dàole xiàngliàn， jiù gǎnmáng huí jiā， dàn tiān tài hēi le， tā mílù le。
pages.en:
So Nozibele went back to the river
alone.
She found her necklace and hurried
home.
But she got lost in the dark.

pages.zh: 她远远地看见有个小木屋，木屋里有一丝光亮。她跑到木屋门口，敲了敲门。
pages.pinyin: tā yuǎn yuǎndì kànjiàn yǒu gè xiǎo mù wū， mù wū lǐ yǒu yī sī guāng liàng。 tā pǎo dào mù wū ménkǒu， qiāo le qiāo mén。
pages.en:
In the distance she saw light
coming from a hut.
She hurried towards it and knocked
at the door.

pages.zh: 诺孜贝儿吃了一惊，开门的是一只会说话的狗：“你来干嘛？”诺孜贝儿说：“我迷路了，我要找个地方睡觉。”狗回答说：“进来吧，不然我就咬你！”然后诺孜贝儿就进了屋。
pages.pinyin: nuò zī bèi ér chī le yī jīng， kāi mén de shì yīzhī huì shuōhuà de gǒu：“nǐ lái gànmá？” nuò zī bèi ér shuō：“wǒ mílù le， wǒ yào zhǎo gè dìfāng shuìjiào。” gǒu huídá shuō：“jìnlái ba， bùrán wǒ jiù yǎo nǐ！” ránhòu nuò zī bèi ér jiù jìn le wū。
pages.en:
To her surprise, a dog opened the
door and said, “What do you want?”
“I’m lost and I need a place to
sleep,” said Nozibele.
“Come in, or I’ll bite you!” said the
dog.
So Nozibele went in.

pages.zh: 狗说：“给我做饭！”诺孜贝儿回答说：“但我从来没有给狗做过饭。”狗说：“快做饭，不然我就咬你。”诺孜贝儿没办法，只能给狗做了一些吃的。
pages.pinyin: gǒu shuō：“gěi wǒ zuòfàn！” nuò zī bèi ér huídá shuō：“dàn wǒ cónglái méiyǒu gěi gǒu zuò guò fàn。” gǒu shuō：“kuài zuòfàn， bùrán wǒ jiù yǎo nǐ。” nuò zī bèi ér méi bànfǎ， zhǐnéng gěi gǒu zuò le yīxiē chī de。
pages.en:
Then the dog said, “Cook for me!”
“But I’ve never cooked for a dog
before,” she answered.
“Cook, or I’ll bite you!” said the dog.
So Nozibele cooked some food for
the dog.

pages.zh: 狗说：“给我铺床！”诺孜贝儿回答说：“但我从来没有给狗铺过床。”狗说：“快铺床，不然我就咬你。”诺孜贝儿没办法，只能给狗铺了床。
pages.pinyin: gǒu shuō：“gěi wǒ pūchuáng！” nuò zī bèi ér huídá shuō：“dàn wǒ cónglái méiyǒu gěi gǒu pù guò chuáng。” gǒu shuō：“kuài pūchuáng， bùrán wǒ jiù yǎo nǐ。” nuò zī bèi ér méi bànfǎ， zhǐnéng gěi gǒu pù le chuáng。
pages.en:
Then the dog said, “Make the bed
for me!”
Nozibele answered, “I’ve never
made a bed for a dog.”
“Make the bed, or I’ll bite you!” the
dog said.
So Nozibele made the bed.

pages.zh: 诺孜贝儿每天都要给狗做饭，打扫屋子，洗衣服。有一天，狗说：“诺孜贝儿，我今天要出门见朋友。在我回来之前，你要打扫好屋子，做好饭，洗好衣服。”
pages.pinyin: nuò zī bèi ér měi tiān dōu yào gěi gǒu zuòfàn， dǎsǎo wūzi， xǐyīfú。 yǒuyītiān， gǒu shuō：“nuò zī bèi ér， wǒ jīntiān yào chūmén jiàn péngyǒu。 zài wǒ huílái zhīqián， nǐ yào dǎsǎo hǎo wūzi， zuò hǎo fàn， xǐ hǎo yīfú。”
pages.en:
Every day she had to cook and
sweep and wash for the dog.
Then one day the dog said,
“Nozibele, today I have to visit
some friends. Sweep the house,
cook the food and wash my things
before I come back.”

pages.zh: 狗一走，诺孜贝儿就从头上拔了三根头发下来。她把一根头发放在床下，一根放在门背后，还有一根放在篱笆上。然后诺孜贝儿用尽全力跑回了家。
pages.pinyin: gǒu yī zǒu， nuò zī bèi ér jiù cóngtóu shàng bá le sān gēn tóufà xiàlái。 tā bǎ yī gēn tóufà fàng zài chuáng xià， yī gēn fàng zài mén bèihòu， hái yǒu yī gēn fàng zài lí bā shàng。 ránhòu nuò zī bèi ér yòng jìnquánlì pǎo huí le jiā。
pages.en:
As soon as the dog had gone,
Nozibele took three hairs from her
head.
She put one hair under the bed, one
behind the door, and one in the
kraal.
Then she ran home as fast as she
could.

pages.zh: 当狗回到家的时候，它开始找诺孜贝儿：“诺孜贝儿，你在哪里？”第一根头发说：“我在这儿，在床底下。”第二根头发说：“我在这儿，在门背后。”第三根头发说：“我在这儿，在篱笆上。”
pages.pinyin: dāng gǒu huí dàojiā de shíhòu， tā kāishǐ zhǎo nuò zī bèi ér：“nuò zī bèi ér， nǐ zài nǎlǐ？” dì yī gēn tóufà shuō：“wǒ zài zhèér， zài chuáng dǐxià。” dì èr gēn tóufà shuō：“wǒ zài zhèér， zài mén bèihòu。” dì sān gēn tóufà shuō：“wǒ zài zhèér， zài lí bā shàng。”
pages.en:
When the dog came back, he looked
for Nozibele.
“Nozibele, where are you?” he
shouted.
“I’m here, under the bed,” said the
first hair.
“I’m here, behind the door,” said the
second hair.
“I’m here, in the kraal,” said the
third hair.

pages.zh: 狗明白了诺孜贝儿耍的花招。它一路跑到诺孜贝儿的村庄，但是诺孜贝儿的兄弟们正拿着棍子等着它呢！狗见状不妙，赶紧跑开了，从此再也没人见过它。
pages.pinyin: gǒu míngbái le nuò zī bèi ér shuǎ de huā zhāo。 tā yīlù pǎo dào nuò zī bèi ér de cūnzhuāng， dànshì nuò zī bèi ér de xiōngdì men zhèng ná zhe gùnzi děng zhe tā ne！ gǒu jiàn zhuàng bùmiào， gǎnjǐn pǎo kāi le， cóngcǐ zài yě méirén jiàn guò tā。
pages.en:
Then the dog knew that Nozibele
had tricked him.
So he ran and ran all the way to the
village.
But Nozibele’s brothers were
waiting there with big sticks.
The dog turned and ran away and
has never been seen since.

stories.title: 指蜜鸟的复仇
stories.author: Zulu folktale

pages.zh: 这是一个关于指蜜鸟奈吉和贪婪的年轻人青其儿的故事。有一天，青其儿外出打猎，忽然，他听到了奈吉的叫声。青其儿一想到跟着指蜜鸟就能找到美味的蜂蜜，口水就忍不住流了出来。他停下来，仔细地听着，四处找寻，直到他在头上的树枝里看到了指蜜鸟。小鸟啾啾啾地叫着，从一根树枝飞到另一个树枝。指蜜鸟一边飞一边叫，让青其儿能跟上它。
pages.pinyin: zhè shì yígè guānyú zhǐ mì niǎo nài jí hé tānlán de niánqīng rén qīng qí ér de gùshì。 yǒuyītiān， qīng qí ér wàichū dǎliè， hūrán， tā tīng dàole nài jí de jiào shēng。 qīng qí ér yī xiǎng dào gēnzhe zhǐ mì niǎo jiù néng zhǎo dào měiwèi de fēngmì， kǒushuǐ jiù rěn búzhù liú le chūlái。 tā tíng xiàlái， zǐxì dì tīng zhe， sìchù zhǎo xún， zhídào tā zài tóu shàng de shùzhī lǐ kàn dàole zhǐ mì niǎo。 xiǎo niǎo jiū jiū jiū dì jiào zhe， cóng yī gēn shùzhī fēi dào lìng yígè shùzhī。 zhǐ mì niǎo yībiān fēi yībiān jiào， ràng qīng qí ér néng gēnshàng tā。
pages.en:
This is the story of Ngede, the Honeyguide, and a greedy young man named Gingile.
One day while Gingile was out hunting he heard the call of Ngede. Gingile’s mouth began to water at the thought of honey. He stopped and listened carefully, searching until he saw the bird in the branches above his head.
“Chitik-chitik-chitik,” the little bird rattled, as he flew to the next tree, and the next.
“Chitik, chitik, chitik,” he called, stopping from time to time to be sure that Gingile followed.

pages.zh: 过了大概半个小时，他们到了一棵巨大的野无花果树下。奈吉在树枝间跳来跳去，然后在其中一根树枝上停了下来，它朝青其儿伸出脑袋，好像在说：“就是这儿！快来！别磨磨蹭蹭的。”青其儿站在树下，看不到一只蜜蜂，但是他相信奈吉不会骗他。
pages.pinyin: guò le dàgài bàn gè xiǎoshí， tāmen dàole yī kē jùdà de yě wú huā guǒ shù xià。 nài jí zài shùzhī jiān tiào lái tiào qù， ránhòu zài qízhōng yī gēn shùzhī shàng tíng le xiàlái， tā cháo qīng qí ér shēn chū nǎodài， hǎoxiàng zài shuō：“jiùshì zhèér！ kuài lái！ bié mómó cèng cèng de。” qīng qí ér zhàn zài shù xià， kàn búdào yīzhī mìfēng， dànshì tā xiāngxìn nài jí búhuì piàn tā。
pages.en:
After half an hour, they reached a huge wild fig tree.
Ngede hopped about madly among the branches. He then settled on one branch and cocked his head at Gingile as if to say, “Here it is! Come now! What is taking you so long?”
Gingile couldn’t see any bees from under the tree, but he trusted Ngede.

pages.zh: 青其儿把他打猎的矛搁在树下，搜集了一些干枯的小树枝，点了一堆火。当火慢慢旺起来的时候，他拿了一根又长又干的树枝，伸向火堆中心。这种木头烧起来的时候，会释放出很多烟。青其儿一手拿着树枝的另一头，另一只手抓着树干，开始爬树。
pages.pinyin: qīng qí ér bǎ tā dǎliè de máo gē zài shù xià， sōují le yīxiē gānkū de xiǎo shùzhī， diǎn le yī duī huǒ。 dāng huǒ màn màn wàng qǐlái de shíhòu， tā ná le yī gēn yòu zhǎng yòu gàn de shùzhī， shēn xiàng huǒ duī zhōngxīn。 zhè zhǒng mùtou shāo qǐlái de shíhòu， huì shìfàng chū hěn duō yān。 qīng qí ér yīshǒu ná zhe shùzhī de lìng yītóu， lìng yīzhī shǒu zhuā zhe shùgàn， kāishǐ pá shù。
pages.en:
So Gingile put down his hunting spear under the tree, gathered some dry twigs and made a small fire.
When the fire was burning well, he put a long dry stick into the heart of the fire. This wood was especially known to make lots of smoke while it burned.
He began climbing, holding the cool end of the smoking stick in his teeth.

pages.zh: 不久青其儿就听到了蜜蜂飞来飞去的嗡嗡声。它们在树干里筑了一个巢，正忙着飞进去飞出来。当青其儿爬到蜂巢附近的时候，他把树枝燃烧的一端猛地戳到蜂巢里。蜜蜂们害怕灰烟，它们都吓坏了，赶紧全都飞出来，但它们没忘记给青其儿脸上、身上狠狠地叮上几口。
pages.pinyin: bùjiǔ qīng qí ér jiù tīng dàole mìfēng fēi lái fēi qù de wēng wēng shēng。 tāmen zài shùgàn lǐ zhù le yígè cháo， zhèng máng zhe fēi jìnqù fēi chūlái。 dāng qīng qí ér pá dào fēng cháo fùjìn de shíhòu， tā bǎ shùzhī ránshāo de yī duān měng dì chuō dào fēng cháo lǐ。 mìfēng men hàipà huī yān， tāmen dōu xià huài le， gǎnjǐn quándōu fēi chūlái， dàn tāmen méi wàngjì gěi qīng qí ér liǎn shàng、 shēnshàng hěn hěn dì dīng shàng jǐ kǒu。
pages.en:
Soon he could hear the loud buzzing of the busy bees. They were coming in and out of a hollow in the tree trunk – their hive.
When Gingile reached the hive he pushed the smoking end of the stick into the hollow.
The bees came rushing out, angry and mean. They flew away because they didn’t like the smoke – but not before they had given Gingile some painful stings!

pages.zh: 蜜蜂全都飞出来了，青其儿把手伸进蜂巢里，他挖到了好多蜜块，又甜又香的蜂蜜从蜜块上滴下来，看起来美味极了。他小心翼翼地把蜂蜜块放进肩膀上的袋子里，慢慢地从树上爬下来。
pages.pinyin: mìfēng quándōu fēi chūlái le， qīng qí ér bǎshǒu shēn jìn fēng cháo lǐ， tā wā dàole hǎoduō mì kuài， yòu tián yòu xiāng de fēngmì cóng mì kuài shàng dī xiàlái， kànqǐlái měiwèi jí le。 tā xiǎoxīnyìyì dì bǎ fēngmì kuài fàng jìn jiānbǎng shàng de dàizi lǐ， màn màn dì cóng shù shàng pá xiàlái。
pages.en:
When the bees were out, Gingile pushed his hands into the nest. He took out handfuls of the heavy comb, dripping with rich honey and full of fat, white grubs.
He put the comb carefully in the pouch he carried on his shoulder, and started to climb down the tree.

pages.zh: 奈吉迫不及待地看着青其儿做这些事情，它等着青其儿能送它一小块蜂蜜，作为给他引路的谢礼。青其儿在树枝间轻快地跳来跳去，离地面越来越近。终于青其儿稳稳地落地，奈吉落在他附近的一块石头上，等着青其儿给他的礼物。
pages.pinyin: nài jí pòbùjídài dì kàn zhe qīng qí ér zuò zhèxiē shìqíng， tā děng zhe qīng qí ér néng sòng tā yī xiǎo kuài fēngmì， zuòwéi gěi tā yǐn lù de xiè lǐ。 qīng qí ér zài shùzhī jiān qīng kuài dì tiào lái tiào qù， lí dìmiàn yuè lái yuè jìn。 zhōngyú qīng qí ér wěn wěn dì luòdì， nài jí luò zài tā fùjìn de yī kuài shítou shàng， děng zhe qīng qí ér gěi tā de lǐwù。
pages.en:
Ngede eagerly watched everything that Gingile was doing. He was waiting for him to leave a fat piece of honeycomb as a thank-you offering to the Honeyguide.
Ngede flittered from branch to branch, closer and closer to the ground. Finally Gingile reached the bottom of the tree.
Ngede perched on a rock near the boy and waited for his reward.

pages.zh: 但是青其儿把火灭了，拎起他的矛，开始向家里走去，装作看不见奈吉的样子。奈吉生气地叫着：“给我蜂蜜！给我蜂蜜！”青其儿停下来，盯着小鸟，大笑说：“我的朋友，你也想要蜂蜜，是吗？哈哈，我做了这么多事，被叮了那么多包！我为什么要跟你分享这蜂蜜？”说完，青其儿就走远了。奈吉气极了，他可从来没有被这样对待过！等着吧，它会报仇的。
pages.pinyin: dànshì qīng qí ér bǎ huǒ miè le， līn qǐ tā de máo， kāishǐ xiàng jiālǐ zǒu qù， zhuāng zuò kànbújiàn nài jí de yàngzi。 nài jí shēngqì dì jiào zhe：“gěi wǒ fēngmì！ gěi wǒ fēngmì！” qīng qí ér tíng xiàlái， dīng zhe xiǎo niǎo， dàxiào shuō：“wǒ de péngyǒu， nǐ yě xiǎngyào fēngmì， shì ma？ hāhā， wǒ zuò le zhème duō shì， bèi dīng le nàmeduō bāo！ wǒ wèishénme yào gēn nǐ fēnxiǎng zhè fēngmì？” shuō wán， qīng qí ér jiù zǒu yuǎn le。 nài jí qì jí le， tā kě cónglái méiyǒu bèi zhèyàng duìdài guò！ děng zhe ba， tā huìbào chóu de。
pages.en:
But, Gingile put out the fire, picked up his spear and started walking home, ignoring the bird.
Ngede called out angrily, “VIC-torr! VIC-torrr!”
Gingile stopped, stared at the little bird and laughed aloud. “You want some honey, do you, my friend? Ha! But I did all the work, and got all the stings. Why should I share any of this lovely honey with you?” Then he walked off.
Ngede was furious! This was no way to treat him! But he would get his revenge.

pages.zh: 过了几个星期，青其儿又听到了奈吉的叫声。他想起来美味的蜂蜜，迫不及待地跟着指蜜鸟走了。奈吉领着青其儿走到森林边上，在一棵大树冠上停了下来。青其儿心想：“哈哈，树上肯定有蜂巢。”他迅速地生了一小堆火，拿着燃烧的树枝开始爬树。奈吉停在那儿看着这一切。
pages.pinyin: guò le jǐgè xīngqī， qīng qí ér yòu tīng dàole nài jí de jiào shēng。 tā xiǎng qǐlái měiwèi de fēngmì， pòbùjídài dì gēnzhe zhǐ mì niǎo zǒu le。 nài jí lǐng zhe qīng qí ér zǒu dào sēnlín biānshàng， zài yī kē dàshù guān shàng tíng le xiàlái。 qīng qí ér xīn xiǎng：“hāhā， shù shàng kěndìng yǒu fēng cháo。” tā xùnsù dì shēng le yī xiǎo duī huǒ， ná zhe ránshāo de shùzhī kāishǐ pá shù。 nài jí tíng zài nàér kàn zhe zhè yīqiè。
pages.en:
One day several weeks later Gingile again heard the honey call of Ngede. He remembered the delicious honey, and eagerly followed the bird once again.
After leading Gingile along the edge of the forest, Ngede stopped to rest in a great umbrella thorn. “Ahh,” thought Gingile. “The hive must be in this tree.” He quickly made his small fire and began to climb, the smoking branch in his teeth. Ngede sat and watched.

pages.zh: 青其儿爬着爬着，心里觉得奇怪，怎么他没有听到嗡嗡声呢？他想，蜂巢一定在树冠很深的地方。他拉着树枝，跳上树：没有蜂巢，他看到了一只豹子！豹子非常生气，因为青其儿打扰了它的美梦。豹子眯着眼睛，张开血盆大口，露出了又白又尖的牙齿。
pages.pinyin: qīng qí ér pá zhe pá zhe， xīnlǐ juéde qíguài， zěnme tā méiyǒu tīng dào wēng wēng shēng ne？ tā xiǎng， fēng cháo yídìng zài shùguān hěn shēn de dìfāng。 tā lā zhe shùzhī， tiào shàng shù： méiyǒu fēng cháo， tā kàn dàole yīzhī bào zi！ bào zi fēicháng shēngqì， yīnwèi qīng qí ér dǎrǎo le tā de měi mèng。 bào zi mī zhuóyǎn jīng， zhāng kāi xuèpéndàkǒu， lù chū le yòu bái yòu jiān de yáchǐ。
pages.en:
Gingile climbed, wondering why he didn’t hear the usual buzzing. “Perhaps the hive is deep in the tree,” he thought to himself. He pulled himself up another branch. But instead of the hive, he was staring into the face of a leopard!
Leopard was very angry at having her sleep so rudely interrupted. She narrowed her eyes, opened her mouth to reveal her very large and very sharp teeth.

pages.zh: 青其儿没等到豹子扑向他，就飞快地爬下树。可他爬得太匆忙了，一脚没踩稳，重重地摔在地上，扭到了脚踝。他一瘸一拐地跑走了。幸好豹子还没睡醒，没有追青其儿。指蜜鸟奈吉报了仇，青其儿也学到了教训。
pages.pinyin: qīng qí ér méi děngdào bào zi pū xiàng tā， jiù fēi kuài dì pá xià shù。 kě tā pá dé tài cōngmáng le， yī jiǎo méi cǎi wěn， chóngchóng dì shuāi zài dìshàng， niǔ dàole jiǎo huái。 tā yī qué yī guǎi dì pǎo zǒu le。 xìnghǎo bào zi hái méi shuì xǐng， méiyǒu zhuī qīng qí ér。 zhǐ mì niǎo nài jí bào le chóu， qīng qí ér yě xué dàole jiàoxùn。
pages.en:
Before Leopard could take a swipe at Gingile, he rushed down the tree.
In his hurry he missed a branch, and landed with a heavy thud on the ground twisting his ankle. He hobbled off as fast as he could. Luckily for him, Leopard was still too sleepy to chase him. Ngede, the Honeyguide, had his revenge.
And Gingile learned his lesson.

pages.zh: 从此以后，青其儿的孩子们都听说了奈吉的故事，都非常尊重这只小鸟。他们每次收获蜂蜜的时候，都会把最大的一块留给指蜜鸟。
pages.pinyin: cóngcǐ yǐhòu， qīng qí ér de háizi men dōu tīngshuō le nài jí de gùshì， dōu fēicháng zūnzhòng zhè zhǐ xiǎo niǎo。 tāmen měi cì shōuhuò fēngmì de shíhòu， dūhuì bǎ zuì dà de yī kuài liú gěi zhǐ mì niǎo。
pages.en: And so, when the children of Gingile hear the story of Ngede they have respect for the little bird. Whenever they harvest honey, they make sure to leave the biggest part of the comb for Honeyguide!

stories.title: 我喜欢看书
stories.author: Letta Machoga

pages.zh: 我喜欢看书。
pages.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuān kànshū。
pages.en: I like to read.

pages.zh: 我可以念给谁听呢？
pages.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ niàn gěi shuí tīng ne？
pages.en: Who can I read to?

pages.zh: 小妹妹正在熟睡。
pages.pinyin: xiǎo mèimèi zhèngzài shú shuì。
pages.en: My sister is asleep.

pages.zh: 我可以念给谁听呢？
pages.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ niàn gěi shuí tīng ne？
pages.en: Who can I read to?

pages.zh: 妈妈和奶奶正在忙。
pages.pinyin: māmā hé nǎinǎi zhèngzài máng。
pages.en: My mother and grandmother are busy.

pages.zh: 我可以念给谁听呢？
pages.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ niàn gěi shuí tīng ne？
pages.en: Who can I read to?

pages.zh: 爸爸和爷爷正在忙。
pages.pinyin: bàbà hé yéyé zhèngzài máng。
pages.en: My father and grandfather are busy.

pages.zh: 我可以念给谁听呢？我可以念给自己听！
pages.pinyin: wǒ kěyǐ niàn gěi shuí tīng ne？ wǒ kěyǐ niàn gěi zìjǐ tīng！
pages.en: Who can I read to? I can read to myself!

Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

stories.title: 和植物聊天的卡莱
stories.title_pinyin: hé zhíwù liáo tiān de kǎ lái
stories.author: Ursula Nafula

pages.zh: 这是卡莱。她今年七岁。在肯尼亚当地方言里，这个名字是“美好事物”的意思。
pages.pinyin: zhè shì kǎ lái。 tā jīnnián qī suì。 zài kěn ní yàdāng dìfāng yán lǐ， zhège míngzì shì “měihǎo shìwù” de yìsi。
pages.en: This is Khalai. She is seven years old. Her name means ‘the good one’ in her language, Lubukusu.

pages.zh: 卡莱早上醒来，跟橙子树说：“橙子树啊橙子树，快点长大吧，给我们结好多又大又甜的橙子！”
pages.pinyin: kǎ lái zǎoshàng xǐng lái， gēn chéng zi shù shuō：“chéng zi shù a chéng zi shù， kuài diǎn zhǎngdà ba， gěi wǒmen jié hǎoduō yòu dà yòu tián de chéng zi！”
pages.en: Khalai wakes up and talks to the orange tree. “Please orange tree, grow big and give us lots of ripe oranges.”

pages.zh: 在卡莱走路去上学的路上，她对草地说：“草地啊草地，你一定要长得绿油油的，别干枯了。”
pages.pinyin: zài kǎ lái zǒulù qù shàngxué de lùshàng， tā duì cǎodì shuō：“cǎodì a cǎodì， nǐ yídìng yào zhǎng dé lǜ yóu yóu de， bié gānkū le。”
pages.en: Khalai walks to school. On the way she talks to the grass. “Please grass, grow greener and don’t dry up.”

pages.zh: 卡莱路过了野花，她对野花说：“野花啊野花，你们尽情地开放吧，这样我可以把你们夹在我的头发里。”
pages.pinyin: kǎ lái lùguò le yě huā， tā duì yě huā shuō：“yě huā a yě huā， nǐmen jìnqíng dì kāifàng ba， zhèyàng wǒ kěyǐ bǎ nǐmen jiā zài wǒ de tóufà lǐ。”
pages.en: Khalai passes wild flowers. “Please flowers, keep blooming so I can put you in my hair.”

pages.zh: 在学校，卡莱对操场中间的树说：“小树啊小树，快点长出枝叶吧，这样我们就可以在树荫里读书了。”
pages.pinyin: zài xuéxiào， kǎ lái duì cāochǎng zhōngjiān de shù shuō：“xiǎo shù a xiǎo shù， kuài diǎn zhǎngchū zhīyè ba， zhèyàng wǒmen jiù kěyǐ zài shùyīn lǐ dúshū le。”
pages.en: At school, Khalai talks to the tree in the middle of the compound. “Please tree, put out big branches so we can read under your shade.”

pages.zh: 卡莱还对学校附近的灌木丛说：“灌木啊灌木，你们一定要长得壮壮的，这样坏人就进不了学校了。”
pages.pinyin: kǎ lái hái duì xuéxiào fùjìn de guàn mù cóng shuō：“guàn mù a guàn mù， nǐmen yídìng yào zhǎng dé zhuàng zhuàng de， zhèyàng huàirén jiù jìn bùliǎo xuéxiào le。”
pages.en: Khalai talks to the hedge around her school. “Please grow strong and stop bad people from coming in.”

pages.zh: 当卡莱从学校回到家里，她又去看了看橙子树，问它：“你结橙子了吗？”
pages.pinyin: dāng kǎ lái cóng xuéxiào huí dàojiā lǐ， tā yòu qù kàn le kàn chéng zi shù， wèn tā：“nǐ jié chéng zi le ma？”
pages.en: When Khalai returns home from school, she visits the orange tree. “Are your oranges ripe yet?” asks Khalai.

pages.zh: 卡莱叹了一口气：“橙子还是绿色的，我明天再来看看你吧！或许到了明天你就会给我一只又大又甜的橙子了。”
pages.pinyin: kǎ lái tàn le yìkǒuqì：“chéng zi háishì lǜsè de， wǒ míngtiān zài lái kànkàn nǐ ba！ huòxǔ dàole míngtiān nǐ jiù huì gěi wǒ yīzhī yòu dà yòu tián de chéng zi le。”
pages.en: “The oranges are still green,” sighs Khalai. “I will see you tomorrow orange tree,” says Khalai. “Perhaps then you will have a ripe orange for me!”

stories.attribution: “和植物聊天的卡莱” by Ursula Nafula, illustrated by Jesse Pietersen, Chinese translation by Vicky Liu, narrated by Zhuo Sun; Global Storybooks 中文故事集 (https://global-asp.github.io/storybooks-chinese/stories/zh/0089/), originally African Storybook “Khalai talks to plants”. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

stories.title: 赞玛很棒！
stories.author: Michael Oguttu

pages.zh: 我弟弟睡过头了。我很早起床，因为我很棒！
pages.pinyin: wǒ dìdi shuì guòtóu le。 wǒ hěn zǎo qǐchuáng， yīnwèi wǒ hěn bàng！
pages.en: My little brother sleeps very late. I wake early, because I am great!

pages.zh: 是我让阳光透进来。
pages.pinyin: shì wǒ ràng yángguāng tòu jìnlái。
pages.en: I am the one who lets in the sun.

pages.zh: 妈妈说：“你是我的晨星”。
pages.pinyin: māmā shuō：“nǐ shì wǒ de chén xīng”。
pages.en: “You’re my morning star,” says Ma.

pages.zh: 我自己洗澡。我不需要帮忙。
pages.pinyin: wǒ zìjǐ xǐzǎo。 wǒ bù xūyào bāngmáng。
pages.en: I wash myself, I don’t need any help.

pages.zh: 冷冷的水和臭臭的蓝色肥皂对我来说不算大事。
pages.pinyin: lěng lěng de shuǐ hé chòu chòu de lán sè féizào duì wǒ lái shuō bùsuàn dàshì。
pages.en: I can cope with cold water and blue smelly soap.

pages.zh: 妈妈提醒我：“别忘了刷牙。”我回答：“怎么可能，我不会忘记的！”
pages.pinyin: māmā tíxǐng wǒ：“bié wàng le shuā yá。” wǒ huídá：“zěnme kěnéng， wǒ búhuì wàngjì de！”
pages.en: Ma reminds, “Don’t forget teeth.” I reply, “Never, not me!”

pages.zh: 洗好了以后，我跟爷爷和姑妈打个招呼，向他们问好。
pages.pinyin: xǐ hǎo le yǐhòu， wǒ gēn yéyé hé gū mā dǎ gè zhāo hū， xiàng tāmen wènhǎo。
pages.en: After washing, I greet Grandpa and Auntie, and wish them a good day.

pages.zh: 然后我自己穿好衣服。“妈，我已经长大了！”
pages.pinyin: ránhòu wǒ zìjǐ chuān hǎo yīfú。“mā， wǒ yǐjīng zhǎngdà le！”
pages.en: Then I dress myself, “I’m big now Ma,” I say.

pages.zh: 我会自己扣好衣扣和鞋子。
pages.pinyin: wǒ huì zìjǐ kòu hǎo yī kòu hé xiézi。
pages.en: I can close my buttons and buckle my shoes.

pages.zh: 在上学的路上我跟弟弟说学校的所有消息。
pages.pinyin: zài shàngxué de lùshàng wǒ gēn dìdi shuō xuéxiào de suǒyǒu xiāoxī。
pages.en: And I make sure little brother knows all the school news.

pages.zh: 上课的时候我认真学习。
pages.pinyin: shàngkè de shíhòu wǒ rènzhēn xuéxí。
pages.en: In class I do my best in every way.

pages.zh: 我每天做这几件好事。可是我最喜欢做的是玩玩玩！
pages.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zuò zhè jǐ jiàn hǎoshì。 kěshì wǒ zuì xǐhuān zuò de shì wán wán wán！
pages.en: I do all these good things every day. But the thing I like most, is to play and play!

Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

stories.title: 一粒小种子：旺加里·马塔伊的故事
stories.title_pinyin: yī lì xiǎo zhǒngzi： wàng jiā lǐ · mǎ tǎ yī de gùshì
stories.title_en: A Tiny Seed: The Story of Wangari Maathai
stories.author: Nicola Rijsdijk

origin.title: A Tiny Seed: The Story of Wangari Maathai

pages.zh: 在东非肯尼亚山的山腰上，有一座小村庄，村庄里有一个小女孩和妈妈一起在田里劳作，这个女孩叫旺加里。
pages.pinyin: zài dōng fēi kěn ní yà shān de shān yāo shàng， yǒu yī zuò xiǎo cūnzhuāng， cūnzhuāng lǐ yǒu yígè xiǎonǚ hái hé māmā yìqǐ zài tián lǐ láo zuò， zhège nǚhái jiào wàng jiā lǐ。
pages.en: In a village on the slopes of Mount Kenya in East Africa, a little girl worked in the fields with her mother. Her name was Wangari.

pages.zh: 旺加里很喜欢呆在户外。在她家的农田里，旺加里用弯刀劈开土地，把小种子播撒到温暖的泥土里。
pages.pinyin: wàng jiā lǐ hěn xǐhuān dāi zài hùwài。 zài tā jiā de nóng tián lǐ， wàng jiā lǐ yòng wān dāo pī kāi tǔdì， bǎ xiǎo zhǒngzi bōsǎ dào wēnnuǎn de nítǔ lǐ。
pages.en: Wangari loved being outside. In her family’s food garden she broke up the soil with her machete. She pressed tiny seeds into the warm earth.

pages.zh: 她一天中最喜欢的时候就是日落时分。当天黑了，看不到花花草草时，旺加里就知道她该回家了。她走在农田里的小路上，还要过几条河。
pages.pinyin: tā yī tiān zhōng zuì xǐhuān de shíhòu jiùshì rìluò shífēn。 dàngtiān hēi le， kàn búdào huā huā cǎo cǎo shí， wàng jiā lǐ jiù zhīdào tā gāi huí jiā le。 tā zǒu zài nóng tián lǐ de xiǎo lùshàng， hái yào guò jǐ tiáo hé。
pages.en:
Her favourite time of day was just after sunset. When it got too dark to see the plants, Wangari knew it was time to go home.
She would follow the narrow paths through the fields, crossing rivers as she went.

pages.zh: 旺加里是个聪明的孩子，她迫不及待地想要去上学，但是她的父母希望她能在家，帮着干农活。当旺加里七岁的时候，她的哥哥说服了父母，让旺加里去上学。
pages.pinyin: wàng jiā lǐ shì gè cōngmíng de háizi， tā pòbùjídài dì xiǎngyào qù shàngxué， dànshì tā de fùmǔ xīwàng tā néng zàijiā， bāng zhe gàn nóng huó。 dāng wàng jiā lǐ qī suì de shíhòu， tā dīgē gē shuōfú le fùmǔ， ràng wàng jiā lǐ qù shàngxué。
pages.en:
Wangari was a clever child and couldn’t wait to go to school. But her mother and father wanted her to stay and help them at home.
When she was seven years old, her big brother persuaded her parents to let her go to school.

pages.zh: 旺加里太喜欢学习了。旺加里读了很多书，学到很多知识。她的成绩非常好，最后收到了美国大学的录取信，邀请她去美国读书。旺加里太兴奋了，她真想去世界各地走走看看。
pages.pinyin: wàng jiā lǐ tài xǐhuān xuéxí le。 wàng jiā lǐ dú le hěn duō shū， xué dào hěn duō zhīshí。 tā de chéngjì fēicháng hǎo， zuìhòu shōudào le měi guó dàxué de lùqǔ xìn， yāoqǐng tā qù měi guó dúshū。 wàng jiā lǐ tài xīngfèn le， tā zhēn xiǎng qùshì jiè gèdì zǒu zǒu kànkàn。
pages.en:
She liked to learn! Wangari learnt more and more with every book she read. She did so well at school that she was invited to study in the United States of America.
Wangari was excited! She wanted to know more about the world.

pages.zh: 在美国的大学里，旺加里学到了很多新鲜事物。她研究植物，以及它们的生长过程。她想起她自己是怎么长大的：她和兄弟们在美丽的肯尼亚森林里玩耍。
pages.pinyin: zài měi guó de dàxué lǐ， wàng jiā lǐ xué dàole hěn duō xīnxiān shìwù。 tā yánjiū zhíwù， yǐjí tāmen de shēngzhǎng guòchéng。 tā xiǎng qǐ tā zìjǐ shì zěnme zhǎngdà de： tā hé xiōngdì men zài měilì de kěn ní yà sēnlín lǐ wánshuǎ。
pages.en: At the American university Wangari learnt many new things. She studied plants and how they grow. And she remembered how she grew: playing games with her brothers in the shade of the trees in the beautiful Kenyan forests.

pages.zh: 她学得越多，就越热爱肯尼亚人民。她想要帮助肯尼亚人民过上自由、快乐的生活。她学得越多，就越想念自己在非洲的家乡。
pages.pinyin: tā xué dé yuè duō， jiù yuè rèài kěn ní yà rénmín。 tā xiǎngyào bāngzhù kěn ní yà rénmín guò shàng zìyóu、 kuàilè de shēnghuó。 tā xué dé yuè duō， jiù yuè xiǎngniàn zìjǐ zài fēi zhōu de jiāxiāng。
pages.en:
The more she learnt, the more she realised that she loved the people of Kenya. She wanted them to be happy and free.
The more she learnt, the more she remembered her African home.

pages.zh: 当旺加里完成学业时，她回到了肯尼亚，但是她的祖国已经今非昔比了。大地上建起了农场，妇女们找不到柴火做饭。人们过着穷苦的日子，孩子们饥肠辘辘。
pages.pinyin: dāng wàng jiā lǐ wánchéng xuéyè shí， tā huí dàole kěn ní yà， dànshì tā de zǔguó yǐjīng jīn fēi xī bǐ le。 dàdì shàng jiàn qǐ le nóngchǎng， fùnǚ men zhǎo búdào chái huǒ zuòfàn。 rénmen guò zhe qióng kǔ de rìzi， háizi men jī cháng lù lù。
pages.en: When she had finished her studies, she returned to Kenya. But her country had changed. Huge farms stretched across the land. Women had no wood to make cooking fires. The people were poor and the children were hungry.

pages.zh: 旺加里知道自己要做什么。她教妇女们如何用种子种出大树。妇女们卖树赚钱，补贴家用。妇女们都很高兴。旺加里使她们觉得自己变得坚强勇敢了。
pages.pinyin: wàng jiā lǐ zhīdào zìjǐ yào zuò shénme。 tā jiào fùnǚ men rúhé yòng zhǒngzi zhǒng chū dàshù。 fùnǚ men mài shù zhuàn qián， bǔtiē jiāyòng。 fùnǚ men dōu hěn gāoxìng。 wàng jiā lǐ shǐ tāmen juéde zìjǐ biàn dé jiānqiáng yǒnggǎn le。
pages.en: Wangari knew what to do. She taught the women how to plant trees from seeds. The women sold the trees and used the money to look after their families. The women were very happy. Wangari had helped them to feel powerful and strong.

pages.zh: 时光飞逝，小树长成了参天大树，又汇聚成了森林，河水穿流而过。旺加里的办法传遍了非洲。今天，因为旺加里当初的种子，已经长出了几百万棵大树。
pages.pinyin: shíguāng fēi shì， xiǎo shù zhǎngchéng le cāntiān dàshù， yòu huìjù chéng le sēnlín， hé shuǐ chuān liú ér guò。 wàng jiā lǐ de bànfǎ chuán biàn le fēi zhōu。 jīntiān， yīnwèi wàng jiā lǐ dāngchū de zhǒngzi， yǐjīng zhǎngchū le jǐ bǎiwàn kē dàshù。
pages.en: As time passed, the new trees grew into forests, and the rivers started flowing again. Wangari’s message spread across Africa. Today, millions of trees have grown from Wangari’s seeds.

pages.zh: 旺加里努力工作，引起了全世界的注意，人们授予她诺贝尔和平奖，她是非洲第一位获得这份殊荣的女性。
pages.pinyin: wàng jiā lǐ nǔlì gōngzuò， yǐnqǐ le quán shìjiè de zhùyì， rénmen shòuyǔ tā nuò bèi ěr hépíng jiǎng， tā shìfēi zhōu dì yī wèi huòdé zhè fèn shū róng de nǚxìng。
pages.en: Wangari had worked hard. People all over the world took notice, and gave her a famous prize. It is called the Nobel Peace Prize, and she was the first African woman ever to receive it.

pages.zh: 旺加里在2011年去世，但是每次我们看到大树时，都会想起这位杰出的女性。
pages.pinyin: wàng jiā lǐ zài 2011 nián qùshì， dànshì měi cì wǒmen kàn dào dàshù shí， dūhuì xiǎng qǐ zhè wèi jiéchū de nǚxìng。
pages.en: Wangari died in 2011, but we can think of her every time we see a beautiful tree.

stories.title: 为什么河马没有毛发
stories.author: Basilio Gimo, David Ker

pages.zh: 有一天，兔子在河边散步。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， tùzi zài hé biān sànbù。
pages.en: One day, Rabbit was walking by the riverside.

pages.zh: 河马也在那儿，一边闲逛，一边找些美味的野草来吃。
pages.pinyin: hé mǎ yě zài nàér， yībiān xián guàng， yībiān zhǎo xiē měiwèi de yě cǎo lái chī。
pages.en: Hippo was there too, going for a stroll and eating some nice green grass.

pages.zh: 河马没有看见兔子，她不小心踩到了兔子的脚。兔子尖叫了一声，朝着河马大喊：“该死的河马！没看到你踩到我的脚了吗？”
pages.pinyin: hé mǎ méiyǒu kànjiàn tùzi， tā bù xiǎoxīn cǎi dàole tùzi de jiǎo。 tùzi jiān jiào le yī shēng， cháozhe hé mǎ dà hǎn：“gāi sǐ de hé mǎ！ méi kàn dào nǐ cǎi dào wǒ de jiǎo le ma？”
pages.en:
Hippo didn’t see that Rabbit was there and she accidentally stepped on Rabbit’s foot.
Rabbit started screaming at Hippo, “You Hippo! Can’t you see that you’re stepping on my foot?”

pages.zh: 河马赶紧给兔子道歉：“真不好意思，我的朋友！我没看见你！请原谅我！”兔子哪里会听河马的解释，他气极了，朝着河马大吼：“你肯定是故意的！总有一天你会受到惩罚！”
pages.pinyin: hé mǎ gǎnjǐn gěi tùzi dàoqiàn：“zhēn bùhǎoyìsī， wǒ de péngyǒu！ wǒ méi kànjiàn nǐ！ qǐng yuánliàng wǒ！” tùzi nǎlǐ huì tīng hé mǎ de jiěshì， tā qì jí le， cháozhe hé mǎ dà hǒu：“nǐ kěndìng shì gùyì de！ zǒng yǒuyītiān nǐ huì shòudào chéngfá！”
pages.en:
Hippo apologised to Rabbit, “I’m so sorry. I didn’t see you. Please forgive me!”
But Rabbit wouldn’t listen and he shouted at Hippo, “You did that on purpose! Someday, you’ll see! You’re going to pay!”

pages.zh: 兔子找到了火，他对火说：“趁河马从水里出来吃草的时候，朝她放一把火。她竟敢踩我的脚。”火回答说：“没问题，我的朋友！我这就按你说的做。”
pages.pinyin: tùzi zhǎo dàole huǒ， tā duì huǒ shuō：“chèn hé mǎ cóng shuǐ lǐ chūlái chī cǎo de shíhòu， cháo tā fàng yī bǎ huǒ。 tā jìng gǎn cǎi wǒ de jiǎo。” huǒ huídá shuō：“méi wèntí， wǒ de péngyǒu！ wǒ zhè jiù àn nǐ shuō de zuò。”
pages.en:
Rabbit went to find Fire and said, “Go, burn Hippo when she comes out of the water to eat grass. She stepped on me!”
Fire answered, “No problem, Rabbit, my friend. I’ll do just what you ask.”

pages.zh: 过了一会儿，河马正在离河岸很远的地方吃草。呼的一声，火突然烧起来了，烧到了河马的身上。
pages.pinyin: guò le yīhuìer， hé mǎ zhèngzài lí hé àn hěn yuǎn de dìfāng chī cǎo。 hū de yī shēng， huǒ tūrán shāo qǐlái le， shāo dàole hé mǎ de shēnshàng。
pages.en: Later, Hippo was eating grass far from the river when, “Whoosh!” Fire burst into flame. The flames began to burn Hippo’s hair.

pages.zh: 河马尖叫着，赶紧跑向河边，但是她的毛发已经全部烧毁了。河马伤心地说：“我的毛都被火烧掉了！你烧了我的毛！它们全都不见了！我美丽的毛！”
pages.pinyin: hé mǎ jiān jiào zhe， gǎnjǐn pǎo xiàng hé biān， dànshì tā de máofà yǐjīng quánbù shāohuǐ le。 hé mǎ shāngxīn dì shuō：“wǒ de máo dōu bèi huǒ shāo diào le！ nǐ shāo le wǒ de máo！ tāmen quándōu bújiànle！ wǒ měilì de máo！”
pages.en:
Hippo started to cry and ran for the water. All her hair was burned off by the fire.
Hippo kept crying, “My hair has burned in the fire! My hair is all gone! My beautiful hair!”

pages.zh: 兔子终于报了仇，他高兴坏了；直到现在，河马也不敢离河岸太远，因为她害怕又要被火烧。
pages.pinyin: tùzi zhōngyú bào le chóu， tā gāoxìng huài le； zhídào xiànzài， hé mǎ yě bùgǎn lí hé àn tài yuǎn， yīnwèi tā hàipà yòu yào bèi huǒ shāo。
pages.en:
Rabbit was happy that Hippo’s hair was burned.
And to this day, for fear of fire, the hippo never goes far from the water.

stories.title: 鸡和千足虫
stories.author: Winny Asara

pages.zh: 鸡和千足虫是好朋友，但是它们又互相竞争。有一天，它们决定进行一场足球比赛，看看谁是最棒的球员。
pages.pinyin: jī hé qiān zú chóng shì hǎo péngyǒu， dànshì tāmen yòu hùxiāng jìngzhēng。 yǒuyītiān， tāmen juédìng jìnxíng yīcháng zúqiú bǐsài， kànkàn shuí shì zuì bàng de qiú yuán。
pages.en: Chicken and Millipede were friends. But they were always competing with each other. One day they decided to play football to see who the best player was.

pages.zh: 它们去了球场，开始比赛。鸡跑得飞快，但是千足虫跑得更快。鸡把球踢得很远，但是千足虫踢得更远。鸡开始有点闷闷不乐。
pages.pinyin: tāmen qù le qiúchǎng， kāishǐ bǐsài。 jī pǎo dé fēi kuài， dànshì qiān zú chóng pǎo dé gèng kuài。 jī bǎ qiú tī dé hěn yuǎn， dànshì qiān zú chóng tī dé gèng yuǎn。 jī kāishǐ yǒudiǎn mènmènbùlè。
pages.en: They went to the football field and started their game. Chicken was fast, but Millipede was faster. Chicken kicked far, but Millipede kicked further. Chicken started to feel grumpy.

pages.zh: 最后，它们决定来一场点球大战。第一轮中，千足虫当守门员，鸡只拿到了一分。然后，在第二轮中，鸡做守门员。
pages.pinyin: zuìhòu， tāmen juédìng lái yīcháng diǎn qiú dàzhàn。 dì yī lún zhōng， qiān zú chóng dāng shǒuményuán， jī zhǐ ná dàole yīfēn。 ránhòu， zài dì èr lún zhōng， jī zuò shǒuményuán。
pages.en: They decided to play a penalty shoot-out. First Millipede was goal keeper. Chicken scored only one goal. Then it was the chicken’s turn to defend the goal.

pages.zh: 千足虫猛地一踢，球进了。千足虫运球飞快，又进了一球。千足虫跳起来，打了个头球，又得了一分。千足虫一共得了五分。
pages.pinyin: qiān zú chóng měng dì yī tī， qiú jìn le。 qiān zú chóng yùn qiú fēi kuài， yòu jìn le yī qiú。 qiān zú chóng tiàoqǐlái， dǎ le gètóu qiú， yòu déle yīfēn。 qiān zú chóng yīgòng déle wǔfēn。
pages.en:
Millipede kicked the ball and scored.
Millipede dribbled the ball and scored. Millipede headed the ball and scored. Millipede scored five goals.

pages.zh: 鸡输了，它很生气。千足虫哈哈大笑，因为它的朋友输了球，就无理取闹。
pages.pinyin: jī shū le， tā hěn shēngqì。 qiān zú chóng hāhā dàxiào， yīnwèi tā de péngyǒu shū le qiú， jiù wúlǐ qǔ nào。
pages.en: Chicken was furious that she lost. She was a very bad loser. Millipede started laughing because his friend was making such a fuss.

pages.zh: 鸡生气极了，它张开嘴，一口把千足虫吞了下去。
pages.pinyin: jī shēngqì jí le， tā zhāng kāi zuǐ， yī kǒu bǎ qiān zú chóng tūn le xiàqù。
pages.en: Chicken was so angry that she opened her beak wide and swallowed the millipede.

pages.zh: 鸡回家的路上，遇到了千足虫妈妈。千足虫妈妈问它：“你看见我的孩子了吗？”鸡什么都没说，千足虫妈妈很担心。
pages.pinyin: jī huí jiā de lùshàng， yùdào le qiān zú chóng māmā。 qiān zú chóng māmā wèn tā：“nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de háizi le ma？” jī shénme dōu méi shuō， qiān zú chóng māmā hěn dānxīn。
pages.en:
As Chicken was walking home, she met Mother Millipede. Mother Millipede asked, “Have you seen my child?” Chicken didn’t say anything.
Mother Millipede was worried.

pages.zh: 千足虫妈妈突然听到了一阵微弱的声音：“快帮我，妈妈！”千足虫妈妈看了看周围，仔细地听着，声音是从鸡身体里传出来的。
pages.pinyin: qiān zú chóng māmā tūrán tīng dàole yīzhèn wēiruò de shēngyīn：“kuài bāng wǒ， māmā！” qiān zú chóng māmā kàn le kàn zhōuwéi， zǐxì dì tīng zhe， shēngyīn shì cóng jī shēntǐ lǐ chuán chūlái de。
pages.en: Then Mother Millipede heard a tiny voice. “Help me mom!” cried the voice. Mother Millipede looked around and listened carefully. The voice came from inside the chicken.

pages.zh: 千足虫妈妈大喊道：“快用你神奇的能力！”千足虫会产生一种很难闻的味道，会让鸡觉得很恶心。
pages.pinyin: qiān zú chóng māmā dà hǎn dào：“kuài yòng nǐ shénqí de nénglì！” qiān zú chóng huì chǎnshēng yīzhǒng hěn nánwén de wèidào， huì ràng jī juéde hěn ěxīn。
pages.en: Mother Millipede shouted, “Use your special power my child!” Millipedes can make a bad smell and a terrible taste. Chicken began to feel ill.

pages.zh: 鸡打了一个嗝，咕噜咕噜要吐了，又是打喷嚏又是咳嗽。千足虫太恶心了！
pages.pinyin: jī dǎ le yígè gé， gū lū gū lū yào tǔ le， yòu shì dǎpēntì yòu shì késòu。 qiān zú chóng tài ěxīn le！
pages.en: Chicken burped. Then she swallowed and spat. Then she sneezed and coughed. And coughed. The millipede was disgusting!

pages.zh: 鸡不停地咳嗽，直到把千足虫从胃里咳了出来。千足虫妈妈和孩子赶紧爬上树，藏了起来。
pages.pinyin: jī bù tíng dì késòu， zhídào bǎ qiān zú chóng cóng wèi lǐ ké le chūlái。 qiān zú chóng māmā hé háizi gǎnjǐn pá shàng shù， cáng le qǐlái。
pages.en: Chicken coughed until she coughed out the millipede that was in her stomach. Mother Millipede and her child crawled up a tree to hide.

pages.zh: 从此以后，鸡和千足虫就变成了敌人。
pages.pinyin: cóngcǐ yǐhòu， jī hé qiān zú chóng jiù biànchéng le dírén。
pages.en: From that time, chickens and millipedes were enemies.

stories.title: 很饿的鳄鱼
stories.author: Christian G.

pages.zh: 从前有一条肚子很饿的鳄鱼。
pages.pinyin: cóngqián yǒu yītiáo dǔzi hěn è de èyú。
pages.en: Once there was a very hungry crocodile.

pages.zh:
他慢慢地、悄悄地去找东西吃。
然后……
pages.pinyin: tā màn màn dì、 qiāoqiāo dì qù zhǎo dōngxī chī。 ránhòu……
pages.en: He searched for food slowly and quietly. And then…

pages.zh: 扑通！鳄鱼来了！
pages.pinyin: pū tōng！ èyú lái le！
pages.en: POW!!! The crocodile strikes!

pages.zh: 然后他肚子就不再饿了，很高兴。
pages.pinyin: ránhòu tā dǔzi jiù bùzài è le， hěn gāoxìng。
pages.en: After that he is no longer hungry, and he is happy.

pages.zh: 直到肚子又饿起来了！
pages.pinyin: zhídào dǔzi yòu è qǐlái le！
pages.en: Until he gets hungry again.

Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

stories.title: 母鸡和老鹰
stories.author: Ann Nduku

pages.zh: 很久很久以前，母鸡和老鹰是好朋友。他们和其他的鸟儿住在一起，相安无事，但是他们都不会飞。
pages.pinyin: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐqián， mǔ jī hé lǎo yīng shì hǎo péngyǒu。 tāmen hé qítā de niǎo ér zhù zài yìqǐ， xiāngānwúshì， dànshì tāmen dōu búhuì fēi。
pages.en:
Once upon a time, Hen and
Eagle were friends. They lived
in peace with all the other birds.
None of them could fly.

pages.zh: 有一天，他们住的地方发生了饥荒。老鹰要走很远很远的路才能找到食物。她回来的时候看起来非常疲倦。老鹰说：“这样走太累了！肯定有一种更省力的方法。”
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， tāmen zhù de dìfāng fāshēng le jīhuāng。 lǎo yīng yào zǒu hěn yuǎn hěn yuǎn de lù cáinéng zhǎo dào shíwù。 tā huílái de shíhòu kànqǐlái fēicháng píjuàn。 lǎo yīng shuō：“zhèyàng zǒu tài lèile！ kěndìng yǒu yīzhǒng gèng shěnglì de fāngfǎ。”
pages.en:
One day, there was famine in
the land. Eagle had to walk very
far to find food. She came back
very tired.
“There must be an easier way
to travel!” said Eagle.

pages.zh: 母鸡饱饱地睡了一觉，想到了一个好主意。她开始搜集其他鸟儿掉下来的羽毛，说：“让我们把这些羽毛都缝在我们身上吧，也许这样我们走路就不吃力了。”
pages.pinyin: mǔ jī bǎo bǎo dì shuì le yījiào， xiǎng dàole yígè hǎo zhǔyì。 tā kāishǐ sōují qítā niǎo ér diào xiàlái de yǔ máo， shuō：“ràng wǒmen bǎ zhèxiē yǔ máo dōu fèng zài wǒmen shēnshàng ba， yěxǔ zhèyàng wǒmen zǒulù jiù bùchī lì le。”
pages.en:
After a good night’s sleep, Hen
had a brilliant idea. She began
collecting the fallen feathers
from all their bird friends.
“Let’s sew them together on top
of our own feathers,” she said.
“Perhaps that will make it easier
to travel.”

pages.zh: 老鹰是村庄里唯一一个有银针的，所以她第一个开始缝羽毛。她给自己做了一双非常漂亮的翅膀，做完之后，在母鸡头上飞来飞去。母鸡问老鹰借了针，但她很快就厌烦了缝纫。她把银针留在柜子上，跑到厨房里，给她的孩子做饭。
pages.pinyin: lǎo yīng shì cūnzhuāng lǐ wéiyī yígè yǒu yín zhēn de， suǒyǐ tā dì yígè kāishǐ fèng yǔ máo。 tā gěi zìjǐ zuò le yī shuāng fēicháng piàoliàng de chìbǎng， zuò wán zhīhòu， zài mǔ jītóu shàng fēi lái fēi qù。 mǔ jī wèn lǎo yīng jiè le zhēn， dàn tā hěn kuài jiù yànfán le féngrèn。 tā bǎ yín zhēn liú zài guìzi shàng， pǎo dào chúfáng lǐ， gěi tā de háizi zuòfàn。
pages.en:
Eagle was the only one in the
village with a needle, so she
started sewing first.
She made herself a pair of
beautiful wings and flew high
above Hen.
Hen borrowed the needle but
she soon got tired of sewing.
She left the needle on the
cupboard and went into the
kitchen to prepare food for her
children.

pages.zh: 其他的鸟儿看到老鹰飞得又高又远，非常羡慕。他们问母鸡借了银针，这样他们也可以给自己做翅膀了。过了不久，其他的鸟儿也都能上天飞翔了。
pages.pinyin: qítā de niǎo ér kàn dào lǎo yīng fēi dé yòu gāo yòu yuǎn， fēicháng xiànmù。 tāmen wèn mǔ jī jiè le yín zhēn， zhèyàng tāmen yě kěyǐ gěi zìjǐ zuò chìbǎng le。 guò le bùjiǔ， qítā de niǎo ér yě dōu néng shàngtiān fēixiáng le。
pages.en:
But the other birds had seen
Eagle flying away. They asked
Hen to lend them the needle to
make wings for themselves too.
Soon there were birds flying all
over the sky.

pages.zh: 当最后一只鸟儿归还银针的时候，母鸡不在家。她的孩子拿走了银针，玩来玩去。他们玩厌的时候，就把银针落在了沙地里。
pages.pinyin: dāng zuìhòu yīzhī niǎo ér guīhuán yín zhēn de shíhòu， mǔ jī bùzài jiā。 tā de háizi ná zǒu le yín zhēn， wán lái wán qù。 tāmen wán yàn de shíhòu， jiù bǎ yín zhēn luò zài le shādì lǐ。
pages.en:
When the last bird returned the
borrowed needle, Hen was not
there. So her children took the
needle and started playing with
it.
When they got tired of the
game, they left the needle in
the sand.

pages.zh: 那天下午，老鹰回来了，她问母鸡要回自己的银针，因为她要修补一些松散的羽毛。母鸡找遍了柜子、厨房和后院，都找不到银针。
pages.pinyin: nà tiānxià wǔ， lǎo yīng huílái le， tā wèn mǔ jī yào huí zìjǐ de yín zhēn， yīnwèi tā yào xiūbǔ yīxiē sōngsǎn de yǔ máo。 mǔ jī zhǎo biàn le guìzi、 chúfáng hé hòu yuàn， dōu zhǎo búdào yín zhēn。
pages.en:
Later that afternoon, Eagle
returned. She asked for the
needle to fix some feathers that
had loosened on her journey.
Hen looked on the cupboard.
She looked in the kitchen. She
looked in the yard. But the
needle was nowhere to be
found.

pages.zh: 母鸡求老鹰：“再给我一天吧！明天你就能修补翅膀，飞着去找食物了。”老鹰说：“好，就一天。如果你找不到银针的话，你就要把一个孩子给我作为补偿。”
pages.pinyin: mǔ jī qiú lǎo yīng：“zài gěi wǒ yī tiān ba！ míngtiān nǐ jiù néng xiūbǔ chìbǎng， fēi zhe qù zhǎo shíwù le。” lǎo yīng shuō：“hǎo， jiù yī tiān。 rúguǒ nǐ zhǎo búdào yín zhēn dehuà， nǐ jiùyào bǎ yígè háizi gěi wǒ zuòwéi bǔcháng。”
pages.en:
“Just give me a day,” Hen
begged Eagle. “Then you can
fix your wing and fly away to
get food again.”
“Just one more day,” said Eagle.
“If you can’t find the needle,
you’ll have to give me one of
your chicks as payment.”

pages.zh: 第二天，老鹰来了，她看到母鸡正在沙地里翻来翻去，但是银针还是没有找到。老鹰从天上俯冲下来，抓了一只小鸡就飞走了。从那以后，无论老鹰什么时候出现，她都看到母鸡在沙地里找银针。
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān， lǎo yīng lái le， tā kàn dào mǔ jī zhèngzài shādì lǐ fān lái fān qù， dànshì yín zhēn háishì méiyǒu zhǎo dào。 lǎo yīng cóng tiānshàng fǔchōng xiàlái， zhuā le yīzhī xiǎo jī jiù fēi zǒu le。 cóng nà yǐhòu， wúlùn lǎo yīng shénmeshíhòu chūxiàn， tā dōu kàn dào mǔ jī zài shādì lǐ zhǎo yín zhēn。
pages.en:
When Eagle came the next day,
she found Hen scratching in the
sand, but no needle.
So Eagle flew down very fast
and caught one of the chicks.
She carried it away.
Forever after that, whenever
Eagle appears, she finds Hen
scratching in the sand for the
needle.

pages.zh: 当母鸡在地上看到老鹰的影子时，她就警告自己的孩子：“快躲起来！别呆在这空旷干燥的地上。”孩子们回答她说：“我们不是傻瓜，我们会跑的。”
pages.pinyin: dāng mǔ jī zài dìshàng kàn dào lǎo yīng de yǐngzi shí， tā jiù jǐnggào zìjǐ de háizi：“kuài duǒ qǐlái！ bié dāi zài zhè kōngkuàng gānzào de dìshàng。” háizi men huídá tā shuō：“wǒmen búshì shǎguā， wǒmen huì pǎo de。”
pages.en:
As the shadow of Eagle’s wing
falls on the ground, Hen warns
her chicks. “Get out of the bare
and dry land.”
And they respond:
“We are not fools. We will run.”

stories.title: 驴孩子
stories.author: Lindiwe Matshikiza

pages.zh: 有个女孩最先发现了远处有个奇怪的身影。
pages.pinyin: yǒu gè nǚhái zuì xiān fāxiàn le yuǎnchù yǒu gè qíguài de shēnyǐng。
pages.en: It was a little girl who first saw the mysterious shape in the distance.

pages.zh: 那个身影越靠越近，她看清楚了，那是一个快生孩子的妇女。
pages.pinyin: nàge shēnyǐng yuè kào yuè jìn， tā kànqīng chǔ le， nà shì yígè kuài shēng háizi de fùnǚ。
pages.en: As the shape moved closer, she saw that it was a heavily pregnant woman.

pages.zh: 女孩有点儿害羞，但她还是勇敢地走上前去。和女孩随行的人们说：“我们必须和她呆在一起，我们必须保护她和她的孩子。”
pages.pinyin: nǚhái yǒudiǎnér hàixiū， dàn tā háishì yǒnggǎn dì zǒu shàng qián qù。 hé nǚhái suí xíng de rénmen shuō：“wǒmen bìxū hé tā dāi zài yìqǐ， wǒmen bìxū bǎohù tā hé tā de háizi。”
pages.en:
Shy but brave, the little girl moved nearer to the woman.
“We must keep her with us,” the little girl’s people decided. “We’ll keep her and her child safe.”

pages.zh: 孩子很快就要降生了。“用力啊！”“快拿毯子来！”“水！”“再用点力！”
pages.pinyin: háizi hěn kuài jiùyào jiàngshēng le。“yònglì a！”“kuài ná tǎnzi lái！”“shuǐ！”“zài yòng diǎn lì！”
pages.en:
The child was soon on its way.
“Push!”
“Bring blankets!”
“Water!”
“Puuuuussssshhh!!!”

pages.zh: 当他们看到孩子时，所有人都吓了一跳，“一头驴？”
pages.pinyin: dāng tāmen kàn dào háizi shí， suǒyǒu rén dōu xià le yī tiào，“yītóu lǘ？”
pages.en:
But when they saw the baby, everyone jumped back in shock.
“A donkey?!”

pages.zh: 大家七嘴八舌吵起来。一些人说：“我们说过要保护母亲和孩子的，我们必须这样做。”但是还有一些人反驳说：“但是他们会给我们带来厄运。”
pages.pinyin: dàjiā qīzuǐbāshé chǎo qǐlái。 yīxiē rén shuō：“wǒmen shuō guò yào bǎohù mǔqīn hé háizi de， wǒmen bìxū zhèyàng zuò。” dànshì hái yǒuyīxiē rén fǎnbó shuō：“dànshì tāmen huì gěi wǒmen dài lái èyùn。”
pages.en:
Everyone began to argue.
“We said we would keep mother and child safe, and that’s what we’ll do,” said some.
“But they will bring us bad luck!” said others.

pages.zh: 妇女发现自己又孤零零一人了。她不知道该拿这个奇怪的孩子怎么办，她也不知道自己该怎么办。
pages.pinyin: fùnǚ fāxiàn zìjǐ yòu gūlínglíng yī rén le。 tā bù zhīdào gāi ná zhège qíguài de háizi zěnmebàn， tā yě bù zhīdào zìjǐ gāi zěnmebàn。
pages.en:
And so the woman found herself alone again.
She wondered what to do with this awkward child.
She wondered what to do with herself.

pages.zh: 最后，她决定接受这个孩子，做他的妈妈。
pages.pinyin: zuìhòu， tā juédìng jiēshòu zhège háizi， zuò tā de māmā。
pages.en: But finally she had to accept that he was her child and she was his mother.

pages.zh: 如果这个孩子一直这般大小，不长大的话，一切都会变得不一样。但是这个驴孩子越长越大，现在他再也不能趴在妈妈的背上。无论他多么努力，他始终不能像人类一样。他的妈妈累了，放弃了。有时候，她让他做一些动物会做的工作。
pages.pinyin: rúguǒ zhège háizi yìzhí zhèbān dàxiǎo， bù zhǎngdà dehuà， yīqiè dūhuì biàn dé bùyíyàng。 dànshì zhège lǘ háizi yuè zhǎng yuè dà， xiànzài tā zài yě bùnéng pā zài māmā de bèi shàng。 wúlùn tā duōme nǔlì， tā shǐzhōng bùnéng xiàng rénlèi yīyàng。 tā de māmā lèile， fàngqì le。 yǒushí hòu， tā ràng tā zuò yīxiē dòngwù huì zuò de gōngzuò。
pages.en:
Now, if the child had stayed that same, small size, everything might have been different. But the donkey child grew and grew until he could no longer fit on his mother’s back.
And no matter how hard he tried, he could not behave like a human being. His mother was often tired and frustrated. Sometimes she made him do work meant for animals.

pages.zh: 驴孩子感到迷茫，也很生气。他这个也不能做，那个也不能做。他不能这样，也不能那样。有一天，他太生气了，一脚把他的妈妈踹到地上。
pages.pinyin: lǘ háizi gǎndào mí máng， yě hěn shēngqì。 tā zhège yě bùnéng zuò， nàge yě bùnéng zuò。 tā bùnéng zhèyàng， yě bùnéng nàyàng。 yǒuyītiān， tā tài shēngqì le， yī jiǎo bǎ tā de māmā chuài dào dìshàng。
pages.en:
Confusion and anger built up inside Donkey. He couldn’t do this and he couldn’t do that. He couldn’t be like this and he couldn’t be like that.
He became so angry that, one day, he kicked his mother to the ground.

pages.zh: 驴孩子羞愧极了，他逃跑了，跑得越远越好。
pages.pinyin: lǘ háizi xiūkuì jí le， tā táopǎo le， pǎo dé yuè yuǎn yuè hǎo。
pages.en: Donkey was filled with shame. He started to run away as far and fast as he could.

pages.zh: 当他停下来的时候，天已经黑了，驴孩子迷路了。他在黑暗里哼哼，“咴咴”，黑暗中传来了回声，“咴咴”。他孤零零的一个人，卷成了一团，心中充满烦恼，沉沉地睡去。
pages.pinyin: dāng tā tíng xiàlái de shíhòu， tiān yǐjīng hēi le， lǘ háizi mílù le。 tā zài hēiàn lǐ hēng hēng，“huī huī”， hēiàn zhōng chuán lái le huí shēng，“huī huī”。 tā gūlínglíng de yígè rén， juǎn chéng le yī tuán， xīnzhōng chōngmǎn fánnǎo， chén chén dì shuì qù。
pages.en:
By the time he stopped running, it was night, and Donkey was lost.
“Hee haw?” he whispered to the darkness.
“Hee Haw?” it echoed back. He was alone.
Curling himself into a tight ball, he fell into a deep and troubled sleep.

pages.zh: 驴孩子醒了，他发现有个老人低头盯着他。他看着老人的眼睛，感觉到了一丝希望。
pages.pinyin: lǘ háizi xǐng le， tā fāxiàn yǒu gè lǎorén dītóu dīng zhe tā。 tā kàn zhe lǎorén de yǎnjīng， gǎnjué dàole yī sī xīwàng。
pages.en: Donkey woke up to find a strange old man staring down at him. He looked into the old man’s eyes and started to feel a twinkle of hope.

pages.zh: 驴孩子和老人住在一起，老人教会他很多生存的本领。驴孩子认真地听着，学得很快。老人也学了很多。他们互相帮助，遇到开心的事情就一起哈哈大笑。
pages.pinyin: lǘ háizi hé lǎorén zhù zài yìqǐ， lǎorén jiào huì tā hěn duō shēngcún de běnlǐng。 lǘ háizi rènzhēn dì tīng zhe， xué dé hěn kuài。 lǎorén yě xué le hěn duō。 tāmen hùxiāng bāngzhù， yùdào kāixīn de shìqíng jiù yìqǐ hāhā dàxiào。
pages.en:
Donkey went to stay with the old man, who taught him many different ways to survive.
Donkey listened and learned, and so did the old man. They helped each other, and they laughed together.

pages.zh: 一天早上，老人让驴孩子带他到山顶。
pages.pinyin: yī tiān zǎoshàng， lǎorén ràng lǘ háizi dài tā dào shāndǐng。
pages.en: One morning, the old man asked Donkey to carry him to the top of a mountain.

pages.zh: 他们登上山顶，环绕在云雾中，睡着了。驴孩子梦到他的妈妈生病了，正在呼唤他，然后他就醒了……
pages.pinyin: tāmen dēng shàngshān dǐng， huánrào zài yún wù zhōng， shuìzháo le。 lǘ háizi mèng dào tā de māmā shēngbìng le， zhèngzài hūhuàn tā， ránhòu tā jiù xǐng le……
pages.en:
High up amongst the clouds they fell asleep.
Donkey dreamed that his mother was sick and calling to him.
And when he woke up…

pages.zh: ……云雾消失了，他的朋友——那个老人——也消失了。
pages.pinyin: …… yún wù xiāoshī le， tā de péngyǒu—— nàge lǎorén—— yě xiāoshī le。
pages.en: … the clouds had disappeared along with his friend, the old man.

pages.zh: 驴孩子终于知道要做什么了。
pages.pinyin: lǘ háizi zhōngyú zhīdào yào zuò shénme le。
pages.en: Donkey finally knew what to do.

pages.zh: 驴孩子找到了他的妈妈，她孤零零一个人，正在为走失的孩子伤心。他们互相打量了很久，然后紧紧地抱在了一起。
pages.pinyin: lǘ háizi zhǎo dàole tā de māmā， tā gūlínglíng yígè rén， zhèngzài wèi zǒu shī de háizi shāngxīn。 tāmen hùxiāng dǎliàng le hěn jiǔ， ránhòu jǐn jǐn dì bào zài le yìqǐ。
pages.en:
Donkey found his mother, alone and mourning her lost child. They stared at each other for a long time.
And then hugged each other very hard.

pages.zh: 驴孩子和妈妈住在一起，慢慢长大，学会了如何共同生活。渐渐的，其他的家庭也搬到他们附近，住了下来。
pages.pinyin: lǘ háizi hé māmā zhù zài yìqǐ， màn màn zhǎngdà， xuéhuì le rúhé gòngtóng shēnghuó。 jiànjiàn de， qítā de jiātíng yě bān dào tāmen fùjìn， zhù le xiàlái。
pages.en:
The donkey child and his mother have grown together and found many ways of living side by side.
Slowly, all around them, other families have started to settle.

stories.title: 丁吉和奶牛
stories.author: Ingrid Schechter

pages.zh: 丁吉和奶奶住在一起。
pages.pinyin: dīng jí hé nǎinǎi zhù zài yìqǐ。
pages.en: Tingi lived with his grandmother.

pages.zh: 丁吉以前常常和奶奶一起照看奶牛。
pages.pinyin: dīng jí yǐqián chángcháng hé nǎinǎi yìqǐ zhàokàn nǎi niú。
pages.en: He used to look after the cows with her.

pages.zh: 有一天，村里来了士兵。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， cūn lǐ lái le shìbīng。
pages.en: One day the soldiers came.

pages.zh: 他们把奶牛带走了。
pages.pinyin: tāmen bǎ nǎi niú dài zǒu le。
pages.en: They took the cows away.

pages.zh: 丁吉和奶奶逃离了村庄，躲了起来。
pages.pinyin: dīng jí hé nǎinǎi táo lí le cūnzhuāng， duǒ le qǐlái。
pages.en: Tingi and his grandmother ran away and hid.

pages.zh: 他们白天躲在树丛里。
pages.pinyin: tāmen báitiān duǒ zài shù cóng lǐ。
pages.en: They hid in the bush until night.

pages.zh: 士兵们又回来了。
pages.pinyin: shìbīng men yòu huílái le。
pages.en: Then the soldiers came back.

pages.zh: 奶奶把丁吉藏在树叶底下。
pages.pinyin: nǎinǎi bǎ dīng jí cáng zài shùyè dǐxià。
pages.en: Grandmother hid Tingi under the leaves.

pages.zh: 有个士兵踩到了丁吉藏身的树叶，但是丁吉没有吱声。
pages.pinyin: yǒu gè shìbīng cǎi dàole dīng jí cángshēn de shùyè， dànshì dīng jí méiyǒu zhīshēng。
pages.en: One of the soldiers put his foot right on him, but he kept quiet.

pages.zh: 丁吉和奶奶直到安全了才走出来。
pages.pinyin: dīng jí hé nǎinǎi zhídào ānquán le cái zǒu chūlái。
pages.en: When it was safe, Tingi and his grandmother came out.

pages.zh: 他们悄悄地爬回家。
pages.pinyin: tāmen qiāoqiāo dì pá huí jiā。
pages.en: They crept home very quietly.
