Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

stories.title: 和奶奶一起过暑假
stories.author: Violet Otieno

pages.zh: 欧东格、阿皮尤和他们的爸爸一起生活在城市里。他们非常期待过暑假，因为那个时候他们不用去学校，而且他们还可以去看奶奶。他们的奶奶住在一个渔村里，靠近一片很大的湖泊。
pages.pinyin: ōu dōng gé、 ā pí yóu hé tāmende bàbà yìqǐ shēnghuó zài chéngshì lǐ。 tāmen fēicháng qīdài guò shǔjià， yīnwèi nàge shíhòu tāmen bùyòng qù xuéxiào， érqiě tāmen hái kěyǐ qù kàn nǎinǎi。 tāmende nǎinǎi zhù zài yígè yú cūn lǐ， kàojìn yīpiàn hěn dà de húpō。
pages.en:
Odongo and Apiyo lived in the city with their father.
They looked forward to the holidays. Not just because school was closed, but because they went to visit their grandmother. She lived in a fishing village near a large lake.

pages.zh: 欧东格和阿皮尤又要去看奶奶了，他们非常高兴。前一天晚上，他们整理好了自己的行装，准备踏上前往渔村的旅程。他们晚上睡不着，整晚都在讨论这个暑假。
pages.pinyin: ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu yòu yào qù kàn nǎinǎi le， tāmen fēicháng gāoxìng。 qián yī tiān wǎnshàng， tāmen zhěnglǐ hǎo le zìjǐ de xíngzhuāng， zhǔnbèi tà shàng qiánwǎng yú cūn de lǚchéng。 tāmen wǎnshàng shuì bù zhe， zhěng wǎn dōu zài tǎolùn zhège shǔjià。
pages.en:
Odongo and Apiyo were excited because it was time to visit their grandmother again.
The night before, they packed their bags and got ready for the long journey to her village. They could not sleep and talked the whole night about the holiday.

pages.zh: 第二天凌晨，他们坐着爸爸的车前往那个渔村。他们开过了山丘，路上看到了很多野生动物，经过了几个茶园。他们唱着歌数着路上的车辆。
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān língchén， tāmen zuò zhe bàbà de chēqián wǎng nàge yú cūn。 tāmen kāi guò le shān qiū， lùshàng kàn dàole hěn duō yěshēng dòngwù， jīngguò le jǐgè chá yuán。 tāmen chàng zhe gē shù zhe lùshàng de chēliàng。
pages.en:
Early the next morning, they left for the village in their father’s car.
They drove past mountains, wild animals and tea plantations. They counted cars and sang songs.

pages.zh: 过了一会儿，孩子们累了，就在车里睡着了。
pages.pinyin: guò le yīhuìer， háizi men lèile， jiù zài chē lǐ shuìzháo le。
pages.en: After a while, the children were tired and fell asleep.

pages.zh: 当他们到达那个渔村的时候，爸爸把欧东格和阿皮尤叫醒了。他们发现他们的奶奶——尼亚·坎亚达——在树荫里铺了一块垫子，正坐在上面休息。在当地的语言里，这个名字的意思是“坎亚达人民的女儿”。她是一个坚强美丽的女性。
pages.pinyin: dāng tāmen dàodá nàge yú cūn de shíhòu， bàbà bǎ ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu jiào xǐng le。 tāmen fāxiàn tāmende nǎinǎi—— ní yà · kǎn yà dá—— zài shùyīn lǐ pù le yī kuài diànzi， zhèng zuò zài shàngmiàn xiūxī。 zài dāngdì de yǔyán lǐ， zhège míngzì de yìsi shì “kǎn yà dá rénmín de nǚér”。 tā shì yígè jiānqiáng měilì de nǚxìng。
pages.en:
Father woke up Odongo and Apiyo as they arrived in the village.
They found Nyar-Kanyada, their grandmother, resting on a mat under a tree.
Nyar-Kanyada in Luo, means ‘daughter of the people of Kanyada’. She was a strong and beautiful woman.

pages.zh: 尼亚·坎亚达欢迎他们来到自己的家里，和他们一起快乐地唱歌跳舞。他们的孙子也很高兴地把他们在城里买的礼物送给她。欧东格和阿皮尤吵着要奶奶先打开自己的礼物。
pages.pinyin: ní yà · kǎn yà dá huānyíng tāmen lái dào zìjǐ de jiālǐ， hé tāmen yìqǐ kuàilè dì chàng gē tiàowǔ。 tāmende sūnzi yě hěn gāoxìng dì bǎ tāmen zài chéng lǐ mǎi de lǐwù sònggěi tā。 ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu chǎo zhe yào nǎinǎi xiān dǎkāi zìjǐ de lǐwù。
pages.en:
Nyar-Kanyada welcomed them into the house and danced around the room singing with joy.
Her grandchildren were excited to give her the presents they brought from the city.
“First open my gift,” said Odongo.
“No, my gift first!” said Apiyo.

pages.zh: 尼亚·坎亚达打开了礼物后，用传统的习俗祝福了她的孙儿们。
pages.pinyin: ní yà · kǎn yà dá dǎkāi le lǐwù hòu， yòng chuántǒng de xísú zhùfú le tā de sūnér men。
pages.en: After she opened the presents, Nyar-Kanyada blessed her grandchildren in a traditional way.

pages.zh: 欧东格和阿皮尤跑出去玩儿了，他们追着蝴蝶和鸟儿，在它们后面跑。
pages.pinyin: ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu pǎo chūqù wán ér le， tāmen zhuī zhe húdié hé niǎo ér， zài tāmen hòumiàn pǎo。
pages.en: Then Odongo and Apiyo went outside. They chased butterflies and birds.

pages.zh: 他们还爬树，跳进湖里，溅起了很多水花。
pages.pinyin: tāmen hái pá shù， tiào jìn hú lǐ， jiàn qǐ le hěn duō shuǐ huā。
pages.en: They climbed trees and splashed in the water of the lake.

pages.zh: 天黑了，他们回到奶奶的家里吃晚饭，但他们太累了，还没吃完，就睡着了。
pages.pinyin: tiān hēi le， tāmen huí dào nǎinǎi de jiālǐ chī wǎnfàn， dàn tāmen tài lèile， hái méi chī wán， jiù shuìzháo le。
pages.en: When it was dark they returned to the house for dinner. Before they could finish eating, they were falling asleep!

pages.zh: 第二天，爸爸开车回城了，把孩子们留给奶奶。
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān， bàbà kāichē huí chéng le， bǎ háizi men liú gěi nǎinǎi。
pages.en: The next day, the children’s father drove back to the city leaving them with Nyar-Kanyada.

pages.zh: 欧东格和阿皮尤帮助奶奶做家务。他们帮奶奶拎水，运柴。他们还帮奶奶从鸡窝里拿鸡蛋，在花园里摘蔬菜。
pages.pinyin: ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu bāngzhù nǎinǎi zuò jiāwù。 tāmen bāng nǎinǎi līn shuǐ， yùn chái。 tāmen hái bāng nǎinǎi cóng jī wō lǐ ná jīdàn， zài huāyuán lǐ zhāi shūcài。
pages.en: Odongo and Apiyo helped their grandmother with household chores. They fetched water and firewood. They collected eggs from the chickens and picked greens from the garden.

pages.zh: 尼亚·坎亚达教他们煮乌咖喱，还教他们怎么做和烤鱼一起吃的椰子饭。
pages.pinyin: ní yà · kǎn yà dá jiào tāmen zhǔ wū gālí， hái jiào tāmen zěnme zuò hé kǎo yú yìqǐ chī de yēzi fàn。
pages.en: Nyar-Kanyada taught her grandchildren to make soft ugali to eat with stew. She showed them how to make coconut rice to eat with roast fish.

pages.zh: 一天早上，欧东格帮奶奶去牧场上放牛，但是牛跑到了邻居的农场上，邻居很生气，威胁欧东格说，要没收了这些牛作为踩坏粮食的赔偿。从那天以后，欧东格很小心，不想再让这些牛惹麻烦了。
pages.pinyin: yī tiān zǎoshàng， ōu dōng gé bāng nǎinǎi qù mùchǎng shàng fàng niú， dànshì niú pǎo dàole línjū de nóngchǎng shàng， línjū hěn shēngqì， wēixié ōu dōng gé shuō， yào mòshōu le zhèxiē niú zuòwéi cǎi huài liángshí de péicháng。 cóng nà tiān yǐhòu， ōu dōng gé hěn xiǎoxīn， bùxiǎng zài ràng zhèxiē niú rě máfán le。
pages.en:
One morning, Odongo took his grandmother’s cows to graze. They ran onto a neighbour’s farm.
The farmer was angry with Odongo. He threatened to keep the cows for eating his crops. After that day, the boy made sure that the cows did not get into trouble again.

pages.zh: 有一天，孩子们和尼亚·坎亚达一起去集市上。奶奶有一个卖蔬菜、糖和肥皂的摊位。阿皮尤给顾客们报价钱，欧东格帮着顾客打包。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， háizi men hé ní yà · kǎn yà dá yìqǐ qù jí shì shàng。 nǎinǎi yǒu yígè mài shūcài、 táng hé féizào de tān wèi。 ā pí yóu gěi gùkè men bàojià qián， ōu dōng gé bāng zhe gùkè dǎbāo。
pages.en:
On another day, the children went to the marketplace with Nyar-Kanyada. She had a stall selling vegetables, sugar and soap.
Apiyo liked to tell customers the price of items. Odongo would pack the items that customers bought.

pages.zh: 这天的工作结束后，他们坐在一起喝茶，帮奶奶数了数这天赚到的钱。
pages.pinyin: zhè tiān de gōngzuò jiéshù hòu， tāmen zuò zài yìqǐ hē chá， bāng nǎinǎi shù le shù zhè tiān zhuàn dào de qián。
pages.en: At the end of the day they drank chai tea together. They helped grandmother to count the money she earned.

pages.zh: 很快，假期就结束了，孩子们要回城了。尼亚·坎亚达送给欧东格一顶帽子，送给阿皮尤一件毛衣。她帮孩子们装了点食物在路上吃。
pages.pinyin: hěn kuài， jiàqī jiù jiéshù le， háizi men yào huí chéng le。 ní yà · kǎn yà dá sònggěi ōu dōng gé yī dǐng màozi， sònggěi ā pí yóu yī jiàn máoyī。 tā bāng háizi men zhuāng le diǎn shíwù zài lùshàng chī。
pages.en:
But too soon the holidays were over and the children had to go back to the city.
Nyar-Kanyada gave Odongo a cap and Apiyo a sweater. She packed food for their journey.

pages.zh: 当爸爸来接他们的时候，他们一点儿都不想走。孩子们求尼亚·坎亚达和他们一起去城里。她笑着说：“我太老了，不适合住在大城市里。我就在这个村子里面等你们，等你们下次再来。”
pages.pinyin: dāng bàbà lái jiē tāmende shíhòu， tāmen yìdiǎnér dōu bùxiǎng zǒu。 háizi men qiú ní yà · kǎn yà dá hé tāmen yìqǐ qù chéng lǐ。 tā xiào zhe shuō：“wǒ tài lǎo le， búshìhé zhù zài dàchéngshì lǐ。 wǒ jiù zài zhège cūn zi lǐmiàn děng nǐmen， děng nǐmen xià cì zài lái。”
pages.en:
When their father came to fetch them, they did not want to leave. The children begged Nyar-Kanyada to go with them to the city.
She smiled and said, “I am too old for the city. I will be waiting for you to come to my village again.”

pages.zh: 欧东格和阿皮尤紧紧地抱着她，跟她告别。
pages.pinyin: ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu jǐn jǐn dì bào zhe tā， gēn tā gàobié。
pages.en: Odongo and Apiyo both hugged her tightly and said goodbye.

pages.zh: 当欧东格和阿皮尤回到学校时，他们把村子里的生活告诉了伙伴们。一些人觉得城市生活很不错，另一些人觉得乡村生活更好。最重要的是，每个人都相信欧东格和阿皮尤的奶奶太棒啦！
pages.pinyin: dāng ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu huí dào xuéxiào shí， tāmen bǎ cūn zi lǐ de shēnghuó gàosù le huǒbàn men。 yīxiē rén juéde chéngshì shēnghuó hěnbúcuò， lìng yīxiē rén juéde xiāngcūn shēnghuó gèng hǎo。 zuì zhòngyào de shì， měi gèrén dōu xiāngxìn ōu dōng gé hé ā pí yóu de nǎinǎi tài bàng la！
pages.en:
When Odongo and Apiyo went back to school they told their friends about life in the village. Some children felt that life in the city was good. Others felt that the village was better.
But most of all, everyone agreed that Odongo and Apiyo had a wonderful grandmother!

stories.title: 玛格威
stories.author: Lesley Koyi

pages.zh: 在内罗毕这座繁忙的城市里，住着一群流浪的男孩，他们日复一日地活着，从来不知道什么是舒适安逸的生活。一天早上，男孩们从冰冷的人行道上醒来，把他们用来睡觉的毯子叠起来。天太冷了，为了驱赶寒气，他们用拾来的垃圾燃起了一堆火。在这群男孩中有一个人叫玛格威。
pages.pinyin: zàinèi luó bì zhè zuò fánmáng de chéngshì lǐ， zhù zhe yī qún liúlàng de nán hái， tāmen rìfùyírì dì huózhe， cónglái bù zhīdào shénme shì shūshì ānyì de shēnghuó。 yī tiān zǎoshàng， nán hái men cóng bīng lěng de rénxíngdào shàng xǐng lái， bǎ tāmen yònglái shuìjiào de tǎnzi dié qǐlái。 tiān tài lěng le， wèile qū gǎn hán qì， tāmen yòng shí lái de lājī rán qǐ le yī duī huǒ。 zài zhè qún nán hái zhōng yǒu yígè rén jiào mǎ gé wēi。
pages.en:
In the busy city of Nairobi, far away from a caring life at home, lived a group of homeless boys. They welcomed each day just as it came.
On one morning, the boys were packing their mats after sleeping on cold pavements. To chase away the cold they lit a fire with rubbish.
Among the group of boys was Magozwe. He was the youngest.

pages.zh: 玛格威的父母过世时，他只有五岁，他搬去跟叔叔一起生活。叔叔从来不关心玛格威。玛格威在叔叔家挨饿受冻，还要干很多体力活。
pages.pinyin: mǎ gé wēi de fùmǔ guòshì shí， tā zhǐyǒu wǔ suì， tā bān qù gēn shūshū yìqǐ shēnghuó。 shūshū cónglái bùguān xīn mǎ gé wēi。 mǎ gé wēi zài shūshū jiā áiè shòu dòng， hái yào gàn hěn duō tǐlì huó。
pages.en: When Magozwe’s parents died, he was only five years old. He went to live with his uncle. This man did not care about the child. He did not give Magozwe enough food. He made the boy do a lot of hard work.

pages.zh: 一旦玛格威稍有抱怨，叔叔就会对他拳打脚踢。有一次，玛格威问叔叔他能不能去上学，叔叔狠狠地打了他几下，说：“你这傻瓜，用得着上学吗？”玛格威过了三年这样的日子，终于离家出走，无家可归。
pages.pinyin: yídàn mǎ gé wēi shāo yǒu bàoyuàn， shūshū jiù huì duì tā quándǎjiǎotī。 yǒu yī cì， mǎ gé wēi wèn shūshū tā néng bùnéng qù shàngxué， shūshū hěn hěn dì dǎ le tā jǐ xià， shuō：“nǐ zhè shǎguā， yòng dé zhe shàngxué ma？” mǎ gé wēi guò le sān nián zhèyàng de rìzi， zhōngyú líjiā chūzǒu， wújiākěguī。
pages.en:
If Magozwe complained or questioned, his uncle beat him. When Magozwe asked if he could go to school, his uncle beat him and said, “You’re too stupid to learn anything.”
After three years of this treatment Magozwe ran away from his uncle. He started living on the street.

pages.zh: 流浪生活非常艰辛，大多数男孩每天只能混个温饱。他们有时候会被抓起来，有时候会挨打。当他们生病的时候，没有人照顾他们。这群男孩就靠乞讨得来的一点点钱过活，他们有时候也会卖塑料品和旧货赚点钱。有时候别的流浪汉会来找茬，争夺领地，那时候生活就更艰难。
pages.pinyin: liúlàng shēnghuó fēicháng jiānxīn， dàduōshù nán hái měi tiān zhǐnéng hùn gè wēn bǎo。 tāmen yǒushí hòu huì bèi zhuā qǐlái， yǒushí hòu huì áidǎ。 dāng tāmen shēngbìng de shíhòu， méiyǒu rén zhàogù tāmen。 zhè qún nán hái jiù kào qǐtǎo dé lái de yìdiǎn diǎn qián guòhuó， tāmen yǒushí hòu yě huì mài sùliào pǐn hé jiù huò zhuàn diǎn qián。 yǒushí hòu biéde liúlàng hàn huì lái zhǎo chá， zhēngduó lǐngdì， nà shíhòu shēnghuó jiù gèng jiānnán。
pages.en:
Street life was difficult and most of the boys struggled daily just to get food. Sometimes they were arrested, sometimes they were beaten. When they were sick, there was no one to help.
The group depended on the little money they got from begging, and from selling plastics and other recycling.
Life was even more difficult because of fights with rival groups who wanted control of parts of the city.

pages.zh: 有一天，玛格威正在翻垃圾箱，他找到了一本破旧不堪的故事书。他把书上的灰尘吹走，把书放进了袋子里。每天完工后，他会把书拿出来，翻着上面的图画，可惜他看不懂上面的文字。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， mǎ gé wēi zhèngzài fān lājī xiāng， tā zhǎo dàole yī běn pòjiù bùkān de gùshì shū。 tā bǎ shū shàng de huīchén chuī zǒu， bǎ shū fàng jìn le dàizi lǐ。 měi tiān wán gōng hòu， tā huì bǎ shū ná chūlái， fān zhe shàngmiàn de túhuà， kěxī tā kàn bù dǒng shàngmiàn de wénzì。
pages.en:
One day while Magozwe was looking through the dustbins, he found an old tattered storybook. He cleaned the dirt from it and put it in his sack.
Every day after that he would take out the book and look at the pictures. He did not know how to read the words.

pages.zh: 图画书讲的是一个男孩长大成为飞行员的故事。玛格威有时候会梦想自己成为一个飞行员。有时候，他想象着自己就是故事中的男孩。
pages.pinyin: túhuà shū jiǎng de shì yígè nán hái zhǎngdà chéngwéi fēixíngyuán de gùshì。 mǎ gé wēi yǒushí hòu huì mèngxiǎng zìjǐ chéngwéi yígè fēixíngyuán。 yǒushí hòu， tā xiǎngxiàng zhe zìjǐ jiùshì gùshì zhōngde nán hái。
pages.en:
The pictures told the story of a boy who grew up to be a pilot.
Magozwe would daydream of being a pilot. Sometimes, he imagined that he was the boy in the story.

pages.zh: 有一天，天气很冷，玛格威站在街头乞讨。一个男人走过来，跟他打招呼：“你好，我叫托马斯。我在这儿附近工作，你可以到那儿拿点吃的。”他指着一座蓝顶黄墙的房子，“我希望你别客气，到那儿去拿点吃的吧！”玛格威看了看男人，又看了看房子，说：“可能吧！”然后他就走开了。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， tiānqì hěn lěng， mǎ gé wēi zhàn zài jiētóu qǐtǎo。 yígè nánrén zǒu guòlái， gēn tā dǎzhāohū：“nǐhǎo， wǒ jiào tuō mǎ sī。 wǒ zài zhèér fùjìn gōngzuò， nǐ kěyǐ dào nàér ná diǎn chī de。” tāzhǐ zhe yī zuò lán dǐng huáng qiáng de fángzi，“wǒ xīwàng nǐ bié kèqì， dào nàér qù ná diǎn chī de ba！” mǎ gé wēi kàn le kàn nánrén， yòu kàn le kàn fángzi， shuō：“kěnéng ba！” ránhòu tā jiù zǒu kāi le。
pages.en:
It was cold and Magozwe was standing on the road begging. A man walked up to him. “Hello, I’m Thomas. I work near here, at a place where you can get something to eat,” said the man.
He pointed to a yellow house with a blue roof. “I hope you will go there to get some food?” he asked.
Magozwe looked at the man, and then at the house. “Maybe,” he said, and walked away.

pages.zh: 接下来的几个月，流浪的男孩们渐渐认识了托马斯。他喜欢跟人聊天，特别是无家可归的人。托马斯听别人讲他们的故事。他不苟言笑，非常耐心、有礼貌，尊重他人。一些男孩开始在白天去蓝顶黄墙的房子里找吃的。
pages.pinyin: jiē xiàlái de jǐgè yuè， liúlàng de nán hái men jiànjiàn rènshí le tuō mǎ sī。 tā xǐhuān gēn rén liáo tiān， tèbié shì wújiākěguī de rén。 tuō mǎ sī tīng biérén jiǎng tāmende gùshì。 tā bùgǒuyánxiào， fēicháng nàixīn、 yǒulǐ mào， zūnzhòng tārén。 yīxiē nán hái kāishǐ zài báitiān qù lán dǐng huáng qiáng de fángzi lǐ zhǎo chī de。
pages.en:
Over the months that followed, the homeless boys got used to seeing Thomas around. He liked to talk to people, especially people living on the streets.
Thomas listened to the stories of people’s lives. He was serious and patient, never rude or disrespectful. Some of the boys started going to the yellow and blue house to get food at midday.

pages.zh: 有一天，玛格威正坐在人行道上看故事书，托马斯来了坐在他旁边。托马斯问：“这本书讲了什么故事？”玛格威回答说：“这是关于一个男孩成为飞行员的故事。”托马斯问：“男孩叫什么名字？”玛格威声音低了下去：“我不知道，我不识字。”
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， mǎ gé wēi zhèng zuò zài rénxíngdào shàng kàn gùshì shū， tuō mǎ sī lái le zuò zài tā pángbiān。 tuō mǎ sī wèn：“zhè běn shū jiǎng le shénme gùshì？” mǎ gé wēi huídá shuō：“zhè shì guānyú yígè nán hái chéngwéi fēixíngyuán de gùshì。” tuō mǎ sī wèn：“nán hái jiào shénme míngzì？” mǎ gé wēi shēngyīn dī le xiàqù：“wǒ bù zhīdào， wǒ bù shízì。”
pages.en:
Magozwe was sitting on the pavement looking at his picture book when Thomas sat down next to him.
“What is the story about?” asked Thomas.
“It’s about a boy who becomes a pilot,” replied Magozwe.
“What’s the boy’s name?” asked Thomas.
“I don’t know, I can’t read,” said Magozwe quietly.

pages.zh: 当他们再次见面的时候，玛格威开始跟托马斯讲自己的故事，他的叔叔怎么对他，他怎么逃离了叔叔家。托马斯没说什么，也没有告诉玛格威该怎么做，但是他听得很仔细。有时候他们会一边在蓝顶黄墙的房子里吃东西，一边聊聊天。
pages.pinyin: dāng tāmen zàicì jiànmiàn de shíhòu， mǎ gé wēi kāishǐ gēn tuō mǎ sī jiǎng zìjǐ de gùshì， tā de shūshū zěnme duì tā， tā zěnme táo lí le shūshū jiā。 tuō mǎ sī méi shuō shénme， yě méiyǒu gàosù mǎ gé wēi gāi zěnme zuò， dànshì tā tīng dé hěn zǐxì。 yǒushí hòu tāmen huì yībiān zài lán dǐng huáng qiáng de fángzi lǐ chī dōngxī， yībiān liáo liáo tiān。
pages.en:
When they met, Magozwe began to tell his own story to Thomas. It was the story of his uncle and why he ran away.
Thomas didn’t talk a lot, and he didn’t tell Magozwe what to do, but he always listened carefully.
Sometimes they would talk while they ate at the house with the blue roof.

pages.zh: 玛格威十岁生日的时候，托马斯给了他一本新的故事书，这是关于一个乡下男孩成为足球运动员的故事。托马斯给玛格威讲过这个故事很多次。有一天，托马斯说：“我觉得你应该去上学，去识字。你觉得呢？”托马斯说他知道一个地方，孩子们可以住在那儿，上学。
pages.pinyin: mǎ gé wēi shí suì shēngrì de shíhòu， tuō mǎ sī gěi le tā yī běn xīn de gùshì shū， zhè shì guānyú yígè xiāngxià nán hái chéngwéi zúqiú yùndòngyuán de gùshì。 tuō mǎ sī gěi mǎ gé wēi jiǎng guò zhège gùshì hěn duō cì。 yǒuyītiān， tuō mǎ sī shuō：“wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi qù shàngxué， qù shízì。 nǐ juéde ne？” tuō mǎ sī shuō tā zhīdào yígè dìfāng， háizi men kěyǐ zhù zài nàér， shàngxué。
pages.en:
Around Magozwe’s tenth birthday, Thomas gave him a new storybook. It was a story about a village boy who grew up to be a famous soccer player.
Thomas read that story to Magozwe many times, until one day he said, “I think it’s time you went to school and learned to read. What do you think?” Thomas explained that he knew of a place where children could stay, and go to school.

pages.zh: 玛格威想了想去新地方生活，上学。但是，如果他叔叔说得对，他太笨了上不了学怎么办？如果在新的地方，他又要挨打怎么办？他有点儿害怕，心想：“也许我注定就要睡在马路边。”
pages.pinyin: mǎ gé wēi xiǎng le xiǎng qù xīn dìfāng shēnghuó， shàngxué。 dànshì， rúguǒ tā shūshū shuō dé duì， tā tài bèn le shàng bùliǎo xué zěnmebàn？ rúguǒ zài xīn de dìfāng， tā yòu yào áidǎ zěnmebàn？ tā yǒudiǎnér hàipà， xīn xiǎng：“yěxǔ wǒ zhùdìng jiùyào shuì zài mǎlù biān。”
pages.en:
Magozwe thought about this new place, and about going to school. What if his uncle was right and he was too stupid to learn anything?
What if they beat him at this new place? He was afraid. “Maybe it is better to stay living on the street,” he thought.

pages.zh: 他把自己的想法告诉了托马斯。托马斯对他循循善诱，终于说服了玛格威，他在新地方一定会过上更好的生活。
pages.pinyin: tā bǎ zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ gàosù le tuō mǎ sī。 tuō mǎ sī duì tā xún xún shàn yòu， zhōngyú shuōfú le mǎ gé wēi， tā zài xīn dìfāng yídìng huì guò shàng gèng hǎo de shēnghuó。
pages.en: He shared his fears with Thomas. Over time the man reassured the boy that life could be better at the new place.

pages.zh: 玛格威搬到了新家，新家的屋顶是绿色的。他和两个男孩住一间房间。屋子里还住着其他十个孩子。和他们住在一起的是茜茜阿姨和她的丈夫，还有三只狗，一只猫，一头老山羊。
pages.pinyin: mǎ gé wēi bān dàole xīn jiā， xīn jiā de wū dǐng shì lǜsè de。 tā hé liǎnggè nán hái zhù yī jiān fángjiān。 wūzi lǐ hái zhù zhe qítā shí gè háizi。 hé tāmen zhù zài yìqǐ de shì qiàn qiàn āyí hé tā de zhàngfū， hái yǒu sān zhǐ gǒu， yīzhī māo， yītóu lǎo shānyáng。
pages.en:
And so Magozwe moved into a room in a house with a green roof. He shared the room with two other boys.
Altogether there were ten children living at that house. Along with Auntie Cissy and her husband, three dogs, a cat, and an old goat.

pages.zh: 玛格威开始读书，他遇到了不少困难，很难赶上他的同学们，有时候他差点就要放弃了。但他每次想起故事书里的飞行员和足球运动员，他都坚持了下来，就像他们一样。
pages.pinyin: mǎ gé wēi kāishǐ dúshū， tā yùdào le bùshǎo kùnnán， hěn nán gǎnshàng tā de tóngxué men， yǒushí hòu tā chàdiǎn jiùyào fàngqì le。 dàn tā měi cì xiǎng qǐ gùshì shū lǐ de fēixíngyuán hé zúqiú yùndòngyuán， tā dōu jiānchí le xiàlái， jiù xiàng tāmen yīyàng。
pages.en:
Magozwe started school and it was difficult. He had a lot to catch up. Sometimes he wanted to give up.
But he thought about the pilot and the soccer player in the storybooks. Like them, he did not give up.

pages.zh: 有一天，玛格威正在屋子后院里看书，托马斯来了，坐在他旁边：“这本书讲了什么故事？”玛格威回答说：“这是关于一个男孩变成老师的故事。”托马斯问：“那个男孩叫什么名字？”玛格威咧嘴一笑：“他叫玛格威。”
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， mǎ gé wēi zhèngzài wūzi hòu yuàn lǐ kànshū， tuō mǎ sī lái le， zuò zài tā pángbiān：“zhè běn shū jiǎng le shénme gùshì？” mǎ gé wēi huídá shuō：“zhè shì guānyú yígè nán hái biànchéng lǎoshī de gùshì。” tuō mǎ sī wèn：“nàge nán hái jiào shénme míngzì？” mǎ gé wēi liězuǐ yī xiào：“tā jiào mǎ gé wēi。”
pages.en:
Magozwe was sitting in the yard at the house with the green roof, reading a storybook from school. Thomas came up and sat next to him.
“What is the story about?” asked Thomas.
“It’s about a boy who becomes a teacher,” replied Magozwe.
“What’s the boy’s name?” asked Thomas.
“His name is Magozwe,” said Magozwe with a smile.

stories.title: 福思的姐姐说了什么
stories.title_pinyin: fú sī de jiějiě shuō le shénme
stories.author: Nina Orange

pages.zh: 一天早上，福思的奶奶唤他过来说：“福思，你带着这个鸡蛋去你爸妈那儿吧！他们要为你姐姐的婚礼做一个大蛋糕。”
pages.pinyin: yī tiān zǎoshàng， fú sī de nǎinǎi huàn tā guòlái shuō：“fú sī， nǐ dài zhe zhège jīdàn qù nǐ bà mā nàér ba！ tāmen yào wèi nǐ jiějiě de hūnlǐ zuò yígè dà dàngāo。”
pages.en:
Early one morning Vusi’s granny
called him, “Vusi, please take this
egg to your parents. They want to
make a large cake for your sister’s
wedding.”

pages.zh: 福思带着鸡蛋上了路，他遇到了两个正在采水果的男孩。其中一个男孩抓过鸡蛋，朝着果树扔过去，鸡蛋破了。
pages.pinyin: fú sī dài zhe jīdàn shàng le lù， tā yùdào le liǎnggè zhèngzài cǎi shuǐguǒ de nán hái。 qízhōng yígè nán hái zhuā guò jīdàn， cháozhe guǒ shù rēng guòqù， jīdàn pò le。
pages.en:
On his way to his parents, Vusi met
two boys picking fruit. One boy
grabbed the egg from Vusi and shot
it at a tree. The egg broke.

pages.zh: 福思哭了：“你做了什么？那个鸡蛋是用来做蛋糕的，这个蛋糕是送给我姐姐结婚的礼物。没了蛋糕，我姐姐会说什么？”
pages.pinyin: fú sī kū le：“nǐ zuò le shénme？ nàge jīdàn shì yònglái zuò dàngāo de， zhège dàngāo shì sònggěi wǒ jiějiě jiéhūn de lǐwù。 méi le dàngāo， wǒ jiějiě huì shuō shénme？”
pages.en:
“What have you done?” cried Vusi.
“That egg was for a cake. The cake
was for my sister’s wedding. What
will my sister say if there is no
wedding cake?”

pages.zh: 男孩们觉得很抱歉，他们不应该嘲弄福思。其中一个男孩说：“我们没办法帮你做蛋糕，但是我们这儿有一根拐杖，可以送给你姐姐。”福思带上了拐杖，继续上路。
pages.pinyin: nán hái men juéde hěn bàoqiàn， tāmen bù yīnggāi cháonòng fú sī。 qízhōng yígè nán hái shuō：“wǒmen méi bànfǎ bāng nǐ zuò dàngāo， dànshì wǒmen zhèér yǒu yī gēn guǎizhàng， kěyǐ sònggěi nǐ jiějiě。” fú sī dài shàng le guǎizhàng， jìxù shànglù。
pages.en:
The boys were sorry for teasing
Vusi.
“We can’t help with the cake, but
here is a walking stick for your
sister,” said one.
Vusi continued on his journey.

pages.zh: 福思在路上碰到了两个造房子的工人。其中一个工人问他：“我们可以借用一下那根木棍吗？”但是木棍不是很结实，它断了。
pages.pinyin: fú sī zài lùshàng pèng dàole liǎnggè zào fángzi de gōngrén。 qízhōng yígè gōngrén wèn tā：“wǒmen kěyǐ jièyòng yī xià nà gēn mùgùn ma？” dànshì mùgùn búshì hěn jiēshí， tā duàn le。
pages.en:
Along the way he met two men
building a house. “Can we use that
strong stick?” asked one.
But the stick was not strong enough
for building, and it broke.

pages.zh: 福思哭了：“你做了什么？那根木棍是摘水果的人给我的，因为他们打碎了用来做蛋糕的鸡蛋。那个蛋糕是送给我姐姐结婚的礼物。没了鸡蛋，没了蛋糕，没了礼物，我姐姐会说什么？”
pages.pinyin: fú sī kū le：“nǐ zuò le shénme？ nà gēn mùgùn shì zhāi shuǐguǒ de rén gěi wǒ de， yīnwèi tāmen dǎ suì le yònglái zuò dàngāo de jīdàn。 nàge dàngāo shì sònggěi wǒ jiějiě jiéhūn de lǐwù。 méi le jīdàn， méi le dàngāo， méi le lǐwù， wǒ jiějiě huì shuō shénme？”
pages.en:
“What have you done?” cried Vusi.
“That stick was a gift for my sister.
The fruit pickers gave me the stick
because they broke the egg for the
cake. The cake was for my sister’s
wedding. Now there is no egg, no
cake, and no gift. What will my
sister say?”

pages.zh: 造房子的工人觉得很抱歉，因为他们弄断了木棍。其中一个工人说：“我们没办法帮着做蛋糕，但我这儿有一些茅草，可以送给你姐姐。”福思带上茅草，继续上路。
pages.pinyin: zào fángzi de gōngrén juéde hěn bàoqiàn， yīnwèi tāmen nòng duàn le mùgùn。 qízhōng yígè gōngrén shuō：“wǒmen méi bànfǎ bāng zhe zuò dàngāo， dàn wǒ zhèér yǒuyīxiē máo cǎo， kěyǐ sònggěi nǐ jiějiě。” fú sī dài shàng máo cǎo， jìxù shànglù。
pages.en:
The builders were sorry for breaking
the stick.
“We can’t help with the cake, but
here is some thatch for your sister,”
said one.
And so Vusi continued on his
journey.

pages.zh: 在路上，福思遇到了一个农民和一头奶牛。奶牛说：“多么美味的茅草啊！我可以尝一尝吗？”但是茅草太美味了，奶牛把茅草全吃光了！
pages.pinyin: zài lùshàng， fú sī yùdào le yígè nóngmín hé yītóu nǎi niú。 nǎi niú shuō：“duōme měiwèi de máo cǎo a！ wǒ kěyǐ cháng yī cháng ma？” dànshì máo cǎo tài měiwèi le， nǎi niú bǎ máo cǎo quán chī guāng le！
pages.en:
Along the way, Vusi met a farmer
and a cow. “What delicious thatch,
can I have a nibble?” asked the cow.
But the thatch was so tasty that the
cow ate it all!

pages.zh: 福思哭了：“你做了什么？那些茅草是给我姐姐的礼物。造房子的工人给了我那些茅草，因为他们弄断了摘水果的人给我的木棍。摘水果的人给了我木棍，因为他们把做蛋糕的鸡蛋打破了。那个蛋糕是给我姐姐结婚的礼物。现在鸡蛋、蛋糕、礼物都没了。我的姐姐会说什么？”
pages.pinyin: fú sī kū le：“nǐ zuò le shénme？ nàxiē máo cǎo shì gěi wǒ jiějiě de lǐwù。 zào fángzi de gōngrén gěi le wǒ nàxiē máo cǎo， yīnwèi tāmen nòng duàn le zhāi shuǐguǒ de rén gěi wǒ de mùgùn。 zhāi shuǐguǒ de rén gěi le wǒ mùgùn， yīnwèi tāmen bǎ zuò dàngāo de jīdàn dǎpò le。 nàge dàngāo shì gěi wǒ jiějiě jiéhūn de lǐwù。 xiànzài jīdàn、 dàngāo、 lǐwù dōu méi le。 wǒ de jiějiě huì shuō shénme？”
pages.en:
“What have you done?” cried Vusi.
“That thatch was a gift for my
sister. The builders gave me the
thatch because they broke the stick
from the fruit pickers. The fruit
pickers gave me the stick because
they broke the egg for my sister’s
cake. The cake was for my sister’s
wedding. Now there is no egg, no
cake, and no gift. What will my
sister say?”

pages.zh: 奶牛很抱歉，因为它太自私了。农民决定让奶牛跟着福思，作为礼物送给他姐姐。福思继续上路了。
pages.pinyin: nǎi niú hěn bàoqiàn， yīnwèi tā tài zìsī liǎo。 nóngmín juédìng ràng nǎi niú gēnzhe fú sī， zuòwéi lǐwù sònggěi tā jiějiě。 fú sī jìxù shànglù le。
pages.en:
The cow was sorry she was greedy.
The farmer agreed that the cow
could go with Vusi as a gift for his
sister. And so Vusi carried on.

pages.zh: 但是，到了吃晚饭的时候，奶牛跑回农场了，福思也迷路了。他很晚才到姐姐的婚礼上，客人们已经在吃饭了。
pages.pinyin: dànshì， dàole chī wǎnfàn de shíhòu， nǎi niú pǎo huí nóngchǎng le， fú sī yě mílù le。 tā hěn wǎn cái dào jiějiě de hūnlǐ shàng， kèrén men yǐjīng zài chī fàn le。
pages.en:
But the cow ran back to the farmer
at supper time.
And Vusi got lost on his journey.
He arrived very late for his sister’s
wedding. The guests were already
eating.

pages.zh: 福思哭了：“我该怎么办？奶牛本来是农民送给我的礼物，因为奶牛吃了建筑工人给我的茅草。建筑工人给我茅草，因为他们折断了摘水果的人给我的木棍。摘水果的人给了我木棍，因为他们打破了做蛋糕的鸡蛋。那个蛋糕是给我姐姐结婚的礼物。现在，鸡蛋没了，蛋糕没了，礼物也没了。”
pages.pinyin: fú sī kū le：“wǒ gāi zěnmebàn？ nǎi niú běnlái shì nóngmín sònggěi wǒ de lǐwù， yīnwèi nǎi niú chī le jiànzhù gōngrén gěi wǒ de máo cǎo。 jiànzhù gōngrén gěi wǒ máo cǎo， yīnwèi tāmen zhéduàn le zhāi shuǐguǒ de rén gěi wǒ de mùgùn。 zhāi shuǐguǒ de rén gěi le wǒ mùgùn， yīnwèi tāmen dǎpò le zuò dàngāo de jīdàn。 nàge dàngāo shì gěi wǒ jiějiě jiéhūn de lǐwù。 xiànzài， jīdàn méi le， dàngāo méi le， lǐwù yě méi le。”
pages.en:
“What shall I do?” cried Vusi.
“The cow that ran away was a gift,
in return for the thatch the builders
gave me. The builders gave me the
thatch because they broke the stick
from the fruit pickers. The fruit
pickers gave me the stick because
they broke the egg for the cake.
The cake was for the wedding. Now
there is no egg, no cake, and no
gift.”

pages.zh: 福思的姐姐想了一会儿，她说：“我亲爱的兄弟，我不在乎有没有礼物。我们今天聚在这里，我就很高兴了。穿上你漂亮的衣服，我们一起庆祝吧！”福思就照着她的话做了。
pages.pinyin: fú sī de jiějiě xiǎng le yīhuìer， tā shuō：“wǒ qīnài de xiōngdì， wǒ bùzàihū yǒu méiyǒu lǐwù。 wǒmen jīntiān jù zài zhèlǐ， wǒ jiù hěn gāoxìng le。 chuān shàng nǐ piàoliàng de yīfú， wǒmen yìqǐ qìngzhù ba！” fú sī jiù zhàozhe tā dehuà zuò le。
pages.en:
Vusi’s sister thought for a while,
then she said,
“Vusi my brother, I don’t really care
about gifts. I don’t even care about
the cake! We are all here together, I
am happy. Now put on your smart
clothes and let’s celebrate this
day!”
And so that’s what Vusi did.

stories.title: 奶奶的香蕉
stories.author: Ursula Nafula

pages.zh: 奶奶有一座美丽的大花园，里面种满了高粱，杂谷和木薯，但里面最棒的是香蕉。奶奶虽然有很多孙子孙女，但我心里知道她最喜欢我。她常常邀请我去她家，告诉我一些小秘密。但是有一个秘密，她从来没有告诉我，那就是她催熟香蕉的办法。
pages.pinyin: nǎinǎi yǒu yī zuò měilì de dà huāyuán， lǐmiàn zhǒng mǎn le gāo liáng， zá gǔ hé mù shǔ， dàn lǐmiàn zuì bàng de shì xiāngjiāo。 nǎinǎi suīrán yǒu hěn duō sūnzi sūnnǚ， dàn wǒ xīnlǐ zhīdào tā zuì xǐhuān wǒ。 tā chángcháng yāoqǐng wǒ qù tā jiā， gàosù wǒ yīxiē xiǎo mìmì。 dànshì yǒu yígè mìmì， tā cónglái méiyǒu gàosù wǒ， nà jiùshì tā cuī shú xiāngjiāo de bànfǎ。
pages.en:
Grandma’s garden was wonderful, full of sorghum, millet, and cassava.
But best of all were the bananas.
Although Grandma had many grandchildren, I secretly knew that I was her favourite. She invited me often to her house. She also told me little secrets.
But there was one secret she did not share with me: where she ripened bananas.

pages.zh: 有一天，我看到奶奶在门外放了一个巨大的麦秆编成的篮子。我问奶奶这是做什么的，奶奶却只说：“这是我的神秘篮子。”篮子旁边放了几片香蕉叶子，奶奶把叶子来回翻动。我很好奇，问奶奶：“这些叶子是做什么的？”奶奶却只说：“这是我的神秘叶子。”
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， wǒ kàn dào nǎinǎi zài mén wài fàng le yígè jùdà de mài gǎn biān chéng de lánzi。 wǒ wèn nǎinǎi zhè shì zuò shénmede， nǎinǎi què zhǐ shuō：“zhè shì wǒ de shénmì lánzi。” lánzi pángbiān fàng le jǐ piàn xiāngjiāo yèzi， nǎinǎi bǎ yèzi láihuí fān dòng。 wǒ hěn hàoqí， wèn nǎinǎi：“zhèxiē yèzi shì zuò shénmede？” nǎinǎi què zhǐ shuō：“zhè shì wǒ de shénmì yèzi。”
pages.en:
One day I saw a big straw basket placed in the sun outside Grandma’s house. When I asked what it was for, the only answer I got was, “It’s my magic basket.”
Next to the basket, there were several banana leaves that Grandma turned from time to time. I was curious. “What are the leaves for, Grandma?” I asked. The only answer I got was, “They are my magic leaves.”

pages.zh: 我好奇地看着奶奶，香蕉，香蕉叶子还有那个巨大的麦秆编成的篮子。但奶奶却把我打发到妈妈那儿跑腿。我求奶奶：“让我留下来看一看吧！”奶奶却坚持说：“别固执了，按我说的去做。”我只好跑开了。
pages.pinyin: wǒ hàoqí dì kàn zhe nǎinǎi， xiāngjiāo， xiāngjiāo yèzi hái yǒu nàge jùdà de mài gǎn biān chéng de lánzi。 dàn nǎinǎi què bǎ wǒ dǎfā dào māmā nàér pǎotuǐ。 wǒ qiú nǎinǎi：“ràng wǒ liúxià lái kàn yī kànba！” nǎinǎi què jiānchí shuō：“bié gùzhí le， àn wǒ shuō de qù zuò。” wǒ zhǐhǎo pǎo kāi le。
pages.en:
It was so interesting watching Grandma, the bananas, the banana leaves and the big straw basket. But Grandma sent me off to my mother on an errand.
“Grandma, please, let me watch as you prepare…”
“Don’t be stubborn, child, do as you are told,” she insisted. I took off running.

pages.zh: 当我回来的时候，奶奶正坐在外面休息，但是篮子和香蕉都不见了！我问奶奶：“篮子去哪儿了？香蕉去哪儿了？还有那些……”奶奶却说：“它们都在一个神秘的地方。”我太沮丧了！
pages.pinyin: dāng wǒ huílái de shíhòu， nǎinǎi zhèng zuò zài wàimiàn xiūxī， dànshì lánzi hé xiāngjiāo dōu bújiànle！ wǒ wèn nǎinǎi：“lánzi qù nǎér le？ xiāngjiāo qù nǎér le？ hái yǒu nàxiē……” nǎinǎi quèshuō：“tāmen dōu zài yígè shénmì de dìfāng。” wǒ tài jǔsàng le！
pages.en:
When I returned, Grandma was sitting outside but with neither the basket nor the bananas.
“Grandma, where is the basket, where are all the bananas, and where…”
But the only answer I got was, “They are in my magic place.” It was so disappointing!

pages.zh: 过了两天，奶奶让我从她的卧室拿拐杖给她。我一打开门，就闻到了熟香蕉的味道。原来奶奶的神秘篮子就放在卧室里！它上面盖了一条旧毯子，我掀起毯子，使劲地闻着那香味。
pages.pinyin: guò le liǎng tiān， nǎinǎi ràng wǒ cóng tā de wòshì ná guǎizhàng gěi tā。 wǒ yīdǎ kāi mén， jiù wén dàole shú xiāngjiāo de wèidào。 yuánlái nǎinǎi de shénmì lánzi jiù fàng zài wòshì lǐ！ tā shàngmiàn gài le yītiáo jiù tǎnzi， wǒ xiānqǐ tǎnzi， shǐjìn dì wén zhe nà xiāng wèi。
pages.en:
Two days later, Grandma sent me to fetch her walking stick from her bedroom.
As soon as I opened the door, I was welcomed by the strong smell of ripening bananas. In the inner room was grandma’s big magic straw basket. It was well hidden by an old blanket. I lifted it and sniffed that glorious smell.

pages.zh: 奶奶喊我的时候，我吓了一跳：“你在做什么？快把我的拐杖拿来。”我赶紧把拐杖拿出去给奶奶。奶奶看着我，问：“你在笑什么？”我这才意识到，我还在因为发现了这个神奇的秘密窃笑着。
pages.pinyin: nǎinǎi hǎn wǒ de shíhòu， wǒ xià le yī tiào：“nǐ zài zuò shénme？ kuài bǎ wǒ de guǎizhàng ná lái。” wǒ gǎnjǐn bǎ guǎizhàng ná chūqù gěi nǎinǎi。 nǎinǎi kàn zhe wǒ， wèn：“nǐ zài xiào shénme？” wǒ zhè cái yìshí dào， wǒ hái zài yīnwèi fāxiàn le zhège shénqí de mìmì qiè xiào zhe。
pages.en:
Grandma’s voice startled me when she called, “What are you doing? Hurry up and bring me the stick.”
I hurried out with her walking stick. “What are you smiling about?” Grandma asked.
Her question made me realise that I was still smiling at the discovery of her magic place.

pages.zh: 第二天，奶奶来看我妈妈，我又跑到奶奶家去偷看那些熟香蕉。有一把香蕉已经非常熟了。我采了一根香蕉，把它藏在我的裙子里。我小心地盖好篮子，跑到房子后面，偷偷地把香蕉吃了：这是我吃过的最美味的香蕉！
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān， nǎinǎi lái kàn wǒ māmā， wǒ yòu pǎo dào nǎinǎi jiā qù tōu kàn nàxiē shú xiāngjiāo。 yǒu yī bǎ xiāngjiāo yǐjīng fēicháng shú le。 wǒ cǎi le yī gēn xiāngjiāo， bǎ tā cáng zài wǒ de qúnzi lǐ。 wǒ xiǎoxīn dì gài hǎo lánzi， pǎo dào fángzi hòumiàn， tōutōu dì bǎ xiāngjiāo chī le： zhè shì wǒ chī guò de zuì měiwèi de xiāngjiāo！
pages.en:
The following day when grandma came to visit my mother, I rushed to her house to check the bananas once more.
There was a bunch of very ripe ones. I picked one and hid it in my dress. After covering the basket again, I went behind the house and quickly ate it. It was the sweetest banana I had ever tasted.

pages.zh: 第二天，我趁奶奶在花园里摘蔬菜的时候，偷偷跑进房间，去看那些香蕉，香蕉差不多全都熟了。我禁不住诱惑，拿了四根香蕉。我踮起脚离开房间，听到奶奶在咳嗽。我把香蕉藏在裙子下面，若无其事地走开了。
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān， wǒ chèn nǎinǎi zài huāyuán lǐ zhāi shūcài de shíhòu， tōutōu pǎo jìn fángjiān， qù kàn nàxiē xiāngjiāo， xiāngjiāo chàbuduō quándōu shú le。 wǒ jīnbúzhù yòuhuò， ná le sì gēn xiāngjiāo。 wǒ diǎn qǐ jiǎo líkāi fángjiān， tīng dào nǎinǎi zài késòu。 wǒ bǎ xiāngjiāo cáng zài qúnzi xiàmiàn， ruòwúqíshì dì zǒu kāi le。
pages.en:
The following day, when grandma was in the garden picking vegetables, I sneaked in and peered at the bananas.
Nearly all were ripe. I couldn’t help taking a bunch of four.
As I tiptoed towards the door, I heard grandma coughing outside. I just managed to hide the bananas under my dress and walked past her.

pages.zh: 第二天是奶奶赶集的日子。奶奶很早就醒来了，她把成熟的香蕉和木薯运到集市上去卖。我那天没有急着去看她，但我知道，我不可能永远躲着奶奶。
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān shì nǎinǎi gǎn jí de rìzi。 nǎinǎi hěn zǎo jiù xǐng lái le， tā bǎ chéngshú de xiāngjiāo hé mù shǔ yùn dào jí shì shàngqù mài。 wǒ nà tiān méiyǒu jí zhe qù kàn tā， dàn wǒ zhīdào， wǒ bùkě néng yǒngyuǎn duǒ zhe nǎinǎi。
pages.en:
The following day was market day. Grandma woke up early. She always took ripe bananas and cassava to sell at the market.
I did not hurry to visit her that day. But I could not avoid her for long.

pages.zh: 那天傍晚，我被爸爸、妈妈和奶奶叫过去。我知道他们为什么找我。那天晚上，当我上床睡觉的时候，我知道我再也不会偷东西了，不偷奶奶的，不偷爸妈的，不从任何人那里偷东西。
pages.pinyin: nà tiān bàngwǎn， wǒ bèi bàbà、 māmā hé nǎinǎi jiào guòqù。 wǒ zhīdào tāmen wèishénme zhǎo wǒ。 nà tiān wǎnshàng， dāng wǒ shàngchuáng shuìjiào de shíhòu， wǒ zhīdào wǒ zài yě búhuì tōu dōngxī le， bù tōu nǎinǎi de， bù tōu bà mā de， bù cóng rènhé rén nàlǐ tōu dōngxī。
pages.en:
Later that evening I was called by my mother and father, and Grandma. I knew why.
That night as I lay down to sleep, I knew I could never steal again, not from grandma, not from my parents, and certainly not from anyone else.

stories.title: 卖香蕉的汤姆
stories.author: Humphreys Odunga

pages.zh: 汤姆顶着一篮熟透的香蕉。
pages.pinyin: tāng mǔ dǐng zhe yī lán shú tòu de xiāngjiāo。
pages.en: Tom carries a tray of ripe bananas.

pages.zh: 汤姆去集市上卖香蕉。
pages.pinyin: tāng mǔ qù jí shì shàng mài xiāngjiāo。
pages.en: Tom goes to the market to sell bananas.

pages.zh: 很多人去集市上买水果。
pages.pinyin: hěn duō rén qù jí shì shàng mǎi shuǐguǒ。
pages.en: People at the market are buying fruit.

pages.zh: 但是没有人去汤姆那儿，因为他们更喜欢去女人们那儿买。
pages.pinyin: dànshì méiyǒu rén qù tāng mǔ nàér， yīnwèi tāmen gèng xǐhuān qù nǚrén men nàér mǎi。
pages.en:
But no one is buying
Tom’s bananas.
They prefer to buy fruit from women.

pages.zh: 人们说：“在我们这儿，只有女人会去卖水果”。他们问：“什么男人会去卖水果啊？”
pages.pinyin: rénmen shuō：“zài wǒmen zhèér， zhǐyǒu nǚrén huì qù mài shuǐguǒ”。 tāmen wèn：“shénme nánrén huì qù mài shuǐguǒ a？”
pages.en: “In our community, only women sell fruit,” people say. “What kind of a man is this?” people ask.

pages.zh: 但是汤姆没有放弃。他在集市上叫卖：“快来买我的香蕉！又大又甜的香蕉！”
pages.pinyin: dànshì tāng mǔ méiyǒu fàngqì。 tā zài jí shì shàng jiào mài：“kuài lái mǎi wǒ de xiāngjiāo！ yòu dà yòu tián de xiāngjiāo！”
pages.en:
But Tom does not give up.
He calls, “Buy my bananas!
Buy my sweet ripe bananas!”

pages.zh: 有一个妇女从篮子里抓了一把香蕉，仔细地查看。
pages.pinyin: yǒu yígè fùnǚ cóng lánzi lǐ zhuā le yī bǎ xiāngjiāo， zǐxì dì chákàn。
pages.en:
One woman picks up a bunch of bananas from the tray.
She looks at the bananas carefully.

pages.zh: 然后她买了那把香蕉。
pages.pinyin: ránhòu tā mǎi le nà bǎ xiāngjiāo。
pages.en: The woman buys the bananas.

pages.zh: 越来越多的人到汤姆的摊位前。他们买了汤姆的香蕉，吃得津津有味。
pages.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de rén dào tāng mǔ de tān wèi qián。 tāmen mǎi le tāng mǔ de xiāngjiāo， chī dé jīnjīnyǒuwèi。
pages.en:
More people come to the stall.
They buy Tom’s bananas and eat them.

pages.zh: 不一会儿，汤姆的篮子就空了，他数了数自己卖香蕉赚到的钱。
pages.pinyin: bùyīhuìer， tāng mǔ de lánzi jiù kōng le， tā shù le shù zìjǐ mài xiāngjiāo zhuàn dào de qián。
pages.en:
Soon, the tray is empty.
Tom counts the money he earned.

pages.zh: 汤姆用这些钱买了肥皂、糖和面包。他把这些东西放在他的篮子里。
pages.pinyin: tāng mǔ yòng zhèxiē qián mǎi le féizào、 táng huómiàn bāo。 tā bǎ zhèxiē dōngxī fàng zài tā de lánzi lǐ。
pages.en:
Then Tom buys soap, sugar, and bread.
He puts the things in his tray.

pages.zh: 汤姆把篮子稳稳当当地顶在头上，回家了。
pages.pinyin: tāng mǔ bǎ lánzi wěnwěndāngdāng dì dǐng zài tóu shàng， huí jiā le。
pages.en: Tom balances the tray on his head and goes home.

stories.title: 火
stories.author: Deborah Namugosa, Beatrice Nabune, Alison Tukei, Rose Sabano

pages.zh: 你看，火！
pages.pinyin: nǐ kàn， huǒ！
pages.en: Look, fire!

pages.zh: 火烧。
pages.pinyin: huǒ shāo。
pages.en: Fire burns.

pages.zh: 火煮。
pages.pinyin: huǒ zhǔ。
pages.en: Fire cooks.

pages.zh: 火可以用来取暖。
pages.pinyin: huǒ kěyǐ yònglái qǔnuǎn。
pages.en: Fire gives warmth.

pages.zh: 火可以带来光亮。
pages.pinyin: huǒ kěyǐ dài lái guāng liàng。
pages.en: Fire gives light.

pages.zh: 你看，火！
pages.pinyin: nǐ kàn， huǒ！
pages.en: Look, fire!

pages.zh: 火很神奇。
pages.pinyin: huǒ hěn shénqí。
pages.en: Fire is wonderful.

pages.zh: 也很有力量。
pages.pinyin: yě hěn yǒulì liàng。
pages.en: And it is powerful.

stories.title: 萨可满的歌声
stories.author: Ursula Nafula

pages.zh: 萨可满和他的父母，还有四岁的妹妹住在一起，他们住在一个富人的土地上，他们的茅草屋在一排大树的后面。
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn hé tā de fùmǔ， hái yǒu sì suì de mèimèi zhù zài yìqǐ， tāmen zhù zài yígè fù rén de tǔdì shàng， tāmende máo cǎo wū zài yī pái dàshù de hòumiàn。
pages.en:
Sakima lived with his parents and his four year old sister.
They lived on a rich man’s land.
Their grass-thatched hut was at the end of a row of trees.

pages.zh: 萨可满三岁的时候，生了一场大病，从此，萨可满就看不见了，其实萨可满是一个非常有天赋的孩子。
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn sān suì de shíhòu， shēng le yīcháng dàbìng， cóngcǐ， sà kě mǎn jiù kànbújiàn le， qíshí sà kě mǎn shì yígè fēicháng yǒu tiānfù de háizi。
pages.en:
When Sakima was three years old, he fell sick and lost his sight.
Sakima was a talented boy.

pages.zh: 萨可满今年六岁，他会做很多同龄的男孩不会做的事情，比如，萨可满能和村里的老人坐在一起讨论重要的事情。
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn jīnnián liù suì， tā huì zuò hěn duō tónglíng de nán hái búhuì zuò de shìqíng， bǐrú， sà kě mǎn néng hé cūn lǐ de lǎorén zuò zài yìqǐ tǎolùn zhòngyào de shìqíng。
pages.en:
Sakima did many things that other six year old boys did not do.
For example, he could sit with older members of the village and discuss important matters.

pages.zh: 萨可满的父母在富人的家里工作。他们每天早出晚归，萨可满就和妹妹呆在家里。
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn de fùmǔ zài fù rén de jiālǐ gōngzuò。 tāmen měi tiān zǎo chū wǎn guī， sà kě mǎn jiù hé mèimèi dāi zàijiā lǐ。
pages.en:
The parents of Sakima worked at the rich man’s house.
They left home early in the morning and returned late in the evening.
Sakima was left with his little sister.

pages.zh: 萨可满很喜欢唱歌。有一天，他的妈妈问他：“萨可满，你从哪儿学了这些歌？”
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn hěn xǐhuān chàng gē。 yǒuyītiān， tā de māmā wèn tā：“sà kě mǎn， nǐ cóng nǎér xué le zhèxiē gē？”
pages.en:
Sakima loved to sing songs.
One day his mother asked him, “Where do you learn these songs from, Sakima?”

pages.zh: 萨可满回答说：“它们就这样出现在我的脑海里，我想到了这些歌，就把它们唱了出来。”
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn huídá shuō：“tāmen jiù zhèyàng chūxiàn zài wǒ de nǎohǎi lǐ， wǒ xiǎng dàole zhèxiē gē， jiù bǎ tāmen chàng le chūlái。”
pages.en: Sakima answered, “They just come, mother. I hear them in my head and then I sing.”

pages.zh: 萨可满很喜欢给他的妹妹唱歌，特别是她肚子饿的时候。妹妹听着萨可满唱他最喜欢的歌，跟着甜美的歌声摆动起来。
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn hěn xǐhuān gěi tā de mèimèi chàng gē， tèbié shì tā dùziè de shíhòu。 mèimèi tīng zhe sà kě mǎn chàng tā zuì xǐhuān de gē， gēnzhe tiánměi de gēshēng bǎidòng qǐlái。
pages.en:
Sakima liked to sing for his little sister, especially, if she felt hungry.
His sister would listen to him singing his favourite song.
She would sway to the soothing tune.

pages.zh: 萨可满的妹妹经常求他：“再唱一次吧！”萨可满唱了一遍又一遍。
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn de mèimèi jīngcháng qiú tā：“zài chàng yī cì ba！” sà kě mǎn chàng le yī biàn yòu yī biàn。
pages.en:
“Can you sing it again and again, Sakima,” his sister would beg him.
Sakima would accept and sing it over and over again.

pages.zh: 有一天晚上，萨可满的父母回到家以后一句话也不说。萨可满知道一定发生了什么不好的事情。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān wǎnshàng， sà kě mǎn de fùmǔ huí dàojiā yǐhòu yījùhuà yě bù shuō。 sà kě mǎn zhīdào yídìng fāshēng le shénme bùhǎo de shìqíng。
pages.en:
One evening when his parents returned home, they were very quiet.
Sakima knew that there was something wrong.

pages.zh: 萨可满问爸爸妈妈发生了什么事，他这才知道，原来富人的儿子失踪了，富人孤单一人，很伤心。
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn wèn bàbà māmā fāshēng le shénmeshì， tā zhè cái zhīdào， yuánlái fù rén de érzi shīzōng le， fù rén gūdānyìrén， hěn shāngxīn。
pages.en:
“What is wrong, mother, father?” Sakima asked.
Sakima learned that the rich man’s son was missing.
The man was very sad and lonely.

pages.zh: 萨可满对父母说：“我可以给他唱歌，这样他就会高兴起来了。”但是萨可满的父母不喜欢这个主意：“他很有钱，而你只是一个看不见的小男孩。你以为你的歌声会帮到他吗？”
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn duì fùmǔ shuō：“wǒ kěyǐ gěi tā chàng gē， zhèyàng tā jiù huì gāoxìng qǐlái le。” dànshì sà kě mǎn de fùmǔ bù xǐhuān zhège zhǔyì：“tā hěn yǒuqián， ér nǐ zhǐshì yígè kànbújiàn de xiǎo nán hái。 nǐ yǐwéi nǐ de gēshēng huì bāng dào tā ma？”
pages.en:
“I can sing for him. He might be happy again,” Sakima told his parents.
But his parents dismissed him.
“He is very rich. You are only a blind boy. Do you think your song will help him?”

pages.zh: 但是萨可满没有放弃，他的妹妹也鼓励他。她说：“萨可满的歌声能赶走饥饿，他肯定也能安慰富人。”
pages.pinyin: dànshì sà kě mǎn méiyǒu fàngqì， tā de mèimèi yě gǔlì tā。 tā shuō：“sà kě mǎn de gēshēng néng gǎn zǒu jīè， tā kěndìng yě néng ānwèi fù rén。”
pages.en:
However, Sakima did not give up.
His little sister supported him.
She said, “Sakima’s songs soothe me when I am hungry. They will soothe the rich man too.”

pages.zh: 第二天，萨可满让他的妹妹带他去富人的房子。
pages.pinyin: dì èr tiān， sà kě mǎn ràng tā de mèimèi dài tā qù fù rén de fángzi。
pages.en: The following day, Sakima asked his little sister to lead him to the rich man’s house.

pages.zh: 他站在一扇大窗户的下面，开始唱他最喜欢的歌。慢慢的，富人的脑袋从窗户里伸出来。
pages.pinyin: tā zhàn zài yī shàn dà chuānghù de xiàmiàn， kāishǐ chàng tā zuì xǐhuān de gē。 màn màn de， fù rén de nǎodài cóng chuānghù lǐ shēn chūlái。
pages.en:
He stood below one big window and began to sing his favourite song.
Slowly, the head of the rich man began to show through the big window.

pages.zh: 工人们停下了工作。他们仔细地听着萨可满唱歌。有一个人说：“从来没有人能安慰老板，这个看不见的男孩觉得他可以做到吗？”
pages.pinyin: gōngrén men tíng xià le gōngzuò。 tāmen zǐxì dì tīng zhe sà kě mǎn chàng gē。 yǒu yígè rén shuō：“cónglái méiyǒu rén néng ānwèi lǎobǎn， zhège kànbújiàn de nán hái juéde tā kěyǐ zuò dào ma？”
pages.en:
The workers stopped what they were doing. They listened to Sakima’s beautiful song.
But one man said, “Nobody has been able to console the boss. Does this blind boy think he will console him?”

pages.zh: 萨可满唱完了，准备离开。富人跑出来，说：“请再唱一遍吧！”
pages.pinyin: sà kě mǎn chàng wánle， zhǔnbèi líkāi。 fù rén pǎo chūlái， shuō：“qǐng zài chàng yī biàn ba！”
pages.en:
Sakima finished singing his song and turned to leave.
But the rich man rushed out and said, “Please sing again.”

pages.zh: 就在那时，两个人抬着担架走来了，担架上是富人的儿子！他们发现这个人被打得面目全非，躺在路边。
pages.pinyin: jiù zài nà shí， liǎnggè rén tái zhe dānjià zǒu lái le， dānjià shàng shì fù rén de érzi！ tāmen fāxiàn zhège rén bèi dǎ dé miànmùquánfēi， tǎng zài lùbiān。
pages.en:
At that very moment, two men came carrying someone on a stretcher.
They had found the rich man’s son beaten up and left on the side of the road.

pages.zh: 富人很高兴儿子找回来了。为了感谢萨可满安慰他，他把萨可满和他的儿子一起送到了医院，萨可满很快就会恢复视力了。
pages.pinyin: fù rén hěn gāoxìng érzi zhǎo huílái le。 wèile gǎnxiè sà kě mǎn ānwèi tā， tā bǎ sà kě mǎn hé tā de érzi yìqǐ sòng dàole yīyuàn， sà kě mǎn hěn kuài jiù huì huīfù shìlì le。
pages.en:
The rich man was so happy to see his son again.
He rewarded Sakima for consoling him.
He took his son and Sakima to hospital so Sakima could regain his sight.

stories.title: 离家进城的那一天
stories.title_pinyin: líjiā jìn chéng de nà yī tiān
stories.title_en: The day I left home for the city
stories.author: Lesley Koyi, Ursula Nafula

origin.title: The day I left home for the city

pages.zh: 在我生活的村庄里，有一个小小的大巴车站。大巴车站虽然小，但是人来车往，非常热闹，地上常常堆满了装载的货物，售票员叫喊着大巴车开往的方向。
pages.pinyin: zài wǒ shēnghuó de cūnzhuāng lǐ， yǒu yígè xiǎo xiǎo de dàbā chēzhàn。 dàbā chēzhàn suīrán xiǎo， dànshì rén lái chē wǎng， fēicháng rènào， dìshàng chángcháng duī mǎn le zhuāngzài de huòwù， shòu piào yuán jiào hǎn zhe dàbā chē kāi wǎng de fāngxiàng。
pages.en: The small bus stop in my village was busy with people and overloaded buses. On the ground were even more things to load. Touts were shouting the names where their buses were going.

pages.zh: 我听到售票员喊“进城啦！进城啦！往西去！”这就是我要乘坐的大巴车。
pages.pinyin: wǒ tīng dào shòu piào yuán hǎn “jìn chéng la！ jìn chéng la！ wǎng xī qù！” zhè jiùshì wǒ yào chéngzuò de dàbā chē。
pages.en: “City! City! Going west!” I heard a tout shouting. That was the bus I needed to catch.

pages.zh: 进城的大巴车几乎坐满了，但是人们还是不停地往里面挤。一些人把行李放在车顶，还有一些人把行李放在车厢里的架子上。
pages.pinyin: jìn chéng de dàbā chē jīhū zuò mǎn le， dànshì rénmen háishì bù tíng dì wǎng lǐmiàn jǐ。 yīxiē rén bǎ xínglǐ fàng zài chē dǐng， hái yǒuyīxiē rén bǎ xínglǐ fàng zài chēxiāng lǐ de jiàzi shàng。
pages.en: The city bus was almost full, but more people were still pushing to get on. Some packed their luggage under the bus. Others put theirs on the racks inside.

pages.zh: 刚上车的乘客们紧紧地抓着他们的车票，在拥挤的车厢里寻找座位，带着小孩的妇女们都坐得舒舒服服的。
pages.pinyin: gāng shàngchē de chéngkè men jǐn jǐn dì zhuā zhe tāmende chēpiào， zài yōngjǐ de chēxiāng lǐ xúnzhǎo zuòwèi， dài zhe xiǎo hái de fùnǚ men dōu zuò dé shū shūfú fú de。
pages.en: New passengers clutched their tickets as they looked for somewhere to sit in the crowded bus. Women with young children made them comfortable for the long journey.

pages.zh: 我挤到了窗边的一个座位里。旁边的乘客紧紧地抓着一个绿色的塑料包裹。他穿着破旧的凉鞋和外套，看起来很紧张。
pages.pinyin: wǒ jǐ dàole chuāng biān de yígè zuòwèi lǐ。 pángbiān de chéngkè jǐn jǐn dì zhuā zhe yígè lǜsè de sùliào bāoguǒ。 tā chuānzhe pòjiù de liángxié hé wàitào， kànqǐlái hěn jǐnzhāng。
pages.en: I squeezed in next to a window. The person sitting next to me was holding tightly to a green plastic bag. He wore old sandals, a worn out coat, and he looked nervous.

pages.zh: 我朝窗外看去，这才意识到，我正在离开我长大的村庄，我要进城了！
pages.pinyin: wǒ cháo chuāng wài kàn qù， zhè cái yìshí dào， wǒ zhèngzài líkāi wǒ zhǎngdà de cūnzhuāng， wǒ yào jìn chéng le！
pages.en: I looked outside the bus and realised that I was leaving my village, the place where I had grown up. I was going to the big city.

pages.zh: 货物都装载完了，乘客们都坐好了。小商贩们还在努力地挤到车厢里，向乘客们大声叫卖着货物。他们的话听起来怪好笑的。
pages.pinyin: huòwù dōu zhuāngzài wánle， chéngkè men dōu zuò hǎo le。 xiǎo shāngfàn men hái zài nǔlì dì jǐ dào chēxiāng lǐ， xiàng chéngkè men dàshēng jiào mài zhe huòwù。 tāmende huà tīng qǐlái guài hǎoxiào de。
pages.en: The loading was completed and all passengers were seated. Hawkers still pushed their way into the bus to sell their goods to the passengers. Everyone was shouting the names of what was available for sale. The words sounded funny to me.

pages.zh: 有一些乘客买了饮料，还有一些乘客买了零食，正准备拆开来吃。像我一样没有钱的人只能看着。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyīxiē chéngkè mǎi le yǐnliào， hái yǒuyīxiē chéngkè mǎi le língshí， zhèng zhǔnbèi chāikāi lái chī。 xiàng wǒ yīyàng méiyǒu qián de rén zhǐnéng kàn zhe。
pages.en: A few passengers bought drinks, others bought small snacks and began to chew. Those who did not have any money, like me, just watched.

pages.zh: 大巴车滴滴叫了两声，要开了，小商贩的活动戛然而止。售票员喊着，赶他们下车。
pages.pinyin: dàbā chē dī dī jiào le liǎng shēng， yào kāi le， xiǎo shāngfàn de huódòng jiá ránér zhǐ。 shòu piào yuán hǎn zhe， gǎn tāmen xiàchē。
pages.en: These activities were interrupted by the hooting of the bus, a sign that we were ready to leave. The tout yelled at the hawkers to get out.

pages.zh: 小商贩们推推搡搡下了车。一些人还在忙着找零钱，还有一些人赖着想最后再做点生意。
pages.pinyin: xiǎo shāngfàn men tuī tuī sǎng sǎng xià le chē。 yīxiē rén hái zài máng zhe zhǎo língqián， hái yǒuyīxiē rén lài zhuóxiǎng zuìhòu zài zuò diǎn shēngyì。
pages.en: Hawkers pushed each other to make their way out of the bus. Some gave back change to the travellers. Others made last minute attempts to sell more items.

pages.zh: 大巴车缓缓离开了车站，我看着窗外，不知道今后会不会有机会回来了。
pages.pinyin: dàbā chē huǎn huǎn líkāi le chēzhàn， wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài， bù zhīdào jīnhòu huì búhuì yǒujī huì huílái le。
pages.en: As the bus left the bus stop, I stared out of the window. I wondered if I would ever go back to my village again.

pages.zh: 旅程渐渐展开，车厢里慢慢热了起来，我闭上眼睛，想小睡一会儿。
pages.pinyin: lǚchéng jiànjiàn zhǎnkāi， chēxiāng lǐ màn màn rè le qǐlái， wǒ bì shàng yǎnjīng， xiǎng xiǎo shuì yīhuìer。
pages.en: As the journey progressed, the inside of the bus got very hot. I closed my eyes hoping to sleep.

pages.zh: 但我的思绪却飞回了家。我的妈妈安全吗？我的兔子会卖了赚钱吗？我的弟弟会帮着给小树苗浇水吗？
pages.pinyin: dàn wǒ de sīxù què fēi huí le jiā。 wǒ de māmā ānquán ma？ wǒ de tùzi huì mài le zhuàn qián ma？ wǒ de dìdi huì bāng zhe gěi xiǎo shù miáo jiāo shuǐ ma？
pages.en: But my mind drifted back home. Will my mother be safe? Will my rabbits fetch any money? Will my brother remember to water my tree seedlings?

pages.zh: 在路上，我努力记住我叔叔在城市里的地址。我迷迷糊糊地说着地址，沉沉地睡去。
pages.pinyin: zài lùshàng， wǒ nǔlì jì zhù wǒ shūshū zài chéngshì lǐ de dìzhǐ。 wǒ mímíhūhū dì shuō zhe dìzhǐ， chén chén dì shuì qù。
pages.en: On the way, I memorised the name of the place where my uncle lived in the big city. I was still mumbling it when I fell asleep.

pages.zh: 过了九个小时，我被售票员的叫喊声吵醒了，他在喊乘客坐车回村庄。我一把抓住我的包，跳下了车。
pages.pinyin: guò le jiǔ gè xiǎoshí， wǒ bèi shòu piào yuán de jiào hǎn shēng chǎo xǐng le， tā zài hǎn chéngkè zuòchē huí cūnzhuāng。 wǒ yībǎzhuā zhù wǒ de bāo， tiào xià le chē。
pages.en: Nine hours later, I woke up with loud banging and calling for passengers going back to my village. I grabbed my small bag and jumped out of the bus.

pages.zh: 回程的大巴车很快就坐满了，不久就要开回东边的村庄去了。对我来说，现在最重要的事情就是找到我叔叔的家。
pages.pinyin: huí chéng de dàbā chē hěn kuài jiù zuò mǎn le， bùjiǔ jiùyào kāi huí dōng biān de cūnzhuāng qù le。 duì wǒ lái shuō， xiànzài zuì zhòngyào de shìqíng jiùshì zhǎo dào wǒ shūshū de jiā。
pages.en: The return bus was filling up quickly. Soon it would make its way back east. The most important thing for me now, was to start looking for my uncle’s house.

stories.title: 数数动物
stories.author: Zanele Buthelezi, Thembani Dladla, Clare Verbeek

pages.zh: 一头大象去喝水。
pages.pinyin: yītóu dàxiàng qù hēshuǐ。
pages.en: One elephant is going to drink water.

pages.zh: 两只长颈鹿去喝水。
pages.pinyin: liǎng zhǐ chángjǐnglù qù hēshuǐ。
pages.en: Two giraffes are going to drink water.

pages.zh: 这里有三头水牛和四只鸟，全部都要去喝水。
pages.pinyin: zhèlǐ yǒu sān tóu shuǐ niú hé sì zhǐ niǎo， quánbù dōu yào qù hēshuǐ。
pages.en: Three buffaloes and four birds are also going to drink water.

pages.zh: 五只高角羚和六只疣猪走去喝水。
pages.pinyin: wǔ zhǐ gāo jiǎo líng hé liù zhǐ yóu zhū zǒu qù hēshuǐ。
pages.en: Five impalas and six warthogs are walking to the water.

pages.zh: 七匹斑馬跑去喝水。
pages.pinyin: qī pǐ bān mǎ pǎo qù hēshuǐ。
pages.en: Seven zebras are running to the water.

pages.zh: 水中有八只青蛙，也有九条鱼。
pages.pinyin: shuǐ zhōng yǒu bā zhǐ qīng wā， yě yǒu jiǔ tiáo yú。
pages.en: Eight frogs and nine fish are swimming in the water.

pages.zh:
一头狮子吼叫着。
他也想喝水。
谁怕狮子了？
pages.pinyin: yītóu shīzi hǒu jiào zhe。 tā yě xiǎng hēshuǐ。 shuí pà shīzi le？
pages.en: One lion roars. He also wants to drink. Who is afraid of the lion?

pages.zh: 一头大象和狮子一起喝水。
pages.pinyin: yītóu dàxiàng hé shīzi yìqǐ hēshuǐ。
pages.en: One elephant is drinking water with the lion.

stories.attribution: “数数动物” by Zanele Buthelezi, Thembani Dladla, Clare Verbeek, illustrated by Rob Owen, Chinese translation by dohliam, narrated by Zhuo Sun; Global Storybooks 中文故事集 (https://global-asp.github.io/storybooks-chinese/stories/zh/0327/), originally African Storybook “Counting animals”. Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

stories.title: 蜡做的孩子
stories.author: Southern African Folktale

pages.zh: 很久很久以前，有一家人快乐地生活在一起。
pages.pinyin: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐqián， yǒu yījiārén kuàilè dì shēnghuó zài yìqǐ。
pages.en:
Once upon a time,
there lived a happy
family.

pages.zh: 孩子们从来不打架，还帮助爸爸妈妈做家务，干农活。
pages.pinyin: háizi men cónglái bù dǎjià， hái bāngzhù bàbà māmā zuò jiāwù， gàn nóng huó。
pages.en:
They never fought with
each other. They helped
their parents at home
and in the fields.

pages.zh: 但是他们不能靠近火焰。
pages.pinyin: dànshì tāmen bùnéng kàojìn huǒyàn。
pages.en:
But they were not
allowed to go near a
fire.

pages.zh: 没办法，他们只能在晚上工作，因为他们都是用蜡做的！
pages.pinyin: méi bànfǎ， tāmen zhǐnéng zài wǎnshàng gōngzuò， yīnwèi tāmen dōu shì yòng là zuò de！
pages.en:
They had to do all their
work during the night.
Because they were made of wax!

pages.zh: 但是其中一个男孩非常想出门，他想走到太阳底下看看。
pages.pinyin: dànshì qízhōng yígè nán hái fēicháng xiǎng chūmén， tā xiǎng zǒu dào tàiyáng dǐxià kànkàn。
pages.en:
But one of the boys
longed to go out in the
sunlight.

pages.zh: 有一天，这种渴望太强烈了。虽然他的兄弟们警告过他……
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， zhè zhǒng kěwàng tài qiángliè le。 suīrán tā de xiōngdì men jǐnggào guò tā……
pages.en:
One day the longing
was too strong. His
brothers warned him…

pages.zh: 但是太晚了！他在太阳底下融化了。
pages.pinyin: dànshì tài wǎn le！ tā zài tàiyáng dǐxià rónghuà le。
pages.en:
But it was too late!
He melted in the hot
sun.

pages.zh: 其他蜡做的孩子看到他们的兄弟融化消失了，非常伤心。
pages.pinyin: qítā là zuò de háizi kàn dào tāmende xiōngdì rónghuà xiāoshī le， fēicháng shāngxīn。
pages.en:
The wax children were
so sad to see their
brother melting away.

pages.zh: 但是他们想出了一个好主意：他们把熔化的蜡块捏成了一只鸟。
pages.pinyin: dànshì tāmen xiǎng chū le yígè hǎo zhǔyì： tāmen bǎ rónghuà de là kuài niē chéng le yīzhī niǎo。
pages.en:
But they made a plan.
They shaped the lump
of melted wax into a
bird.

pages.zh: 他们把变成鸟的兄弟带到了一座高山上。
pages.pinyin: tāmen bǎ biànchéng niǎo de xiōngdì dài dàole yī zuò gāo shān shàng。
pages.en:
They took their bird
brother up to a high
mountain.

pages.zh: 太阳升起来了，他迎着晨光唱着歌，飞走了。
pages.pinyin: tàiyáng shēng qǐlái le， tā yíng zhe chén guāng chàng zhe gē， fēi zǒu le。
pages.en:
And as the sun rose, he
flew away singing into
the morning light.

stories.title: 惩罚
stories.author: Adelheid Marie Bwire

pages.zh: 有一天，妈妈买了很多水果。
pages.pinyin: yǒuyītiān， māmā mǎi le hěn duō shuǐguǒ。
pages.en: One day, mama got a lot of fruit.

pages.zh: 我们都问她：“什么时候可以吃水果？”妈妈说：“等今天晚上再吃。”
pages.pinyin: wǒmen dōu wèn tā：“shénmeshíhòu kěyǐ chī shuǐguǒ？” māmā shuō：“děng jīntiān wǎnshàng zài chī。”
pages.en:
“When can we have some fruit?” we ask.
“We will have the fruit tonight,” says mama.

pages.zh: 我哥哥拉希姆很贪吃，所有的水果都想尝尝。结果他吃了很多。
pages.pinyin: wǒ gēgē lā xī mǔ hěn tān chī， suǒyǒu de shuǐguǒ dōu xiǎng cháng cháng。 jiéguǒ tā chī le hěn duō。
pages.en: My brother Rahim is greedy. He tastes all the fruit. He eats a lot of it.

pages.zh: 弟弟叫着说：“看看拉希姆做了什么！”。我跟着说：“拉希姆很调皮很自私。”
pages.pinyin: dìdi jiào zhe shuō：“kànkàn lā xī mǔ zuò le shénme！”。 wǒ gēnzhe shuō：“lā xī mǔ hěn tiáopí hěn zìsī。”
pages.en:
“Look at what Rahim did!” shouts my little brother.
“Rahim is naughty and selfish,” I say.

pages.zh: 妈妈对拉希姆很生气。
pages.pinyin: māmā duì lā xī mǔ hěn shēngqì。
pages.en: Mother is angry with Rahim.

pages.zh: 我们也对拉希姆很生气。可是拉希姆并不感到惭愧。
pages.pinyin: wǒmen yě duì lā xī mǔ hěn shēngqì。 kěshì lā xī mǔ bìng bù gǎndào cánkuì。
pages.en: We are also angry with Rahim. But Rahim is not sorry.

pages.zh: 小弟弟问：“拉希姆不是该罚了吗？”
pages.pinyin: xiǎodì dì wèn：“lā xī mǔ búshì gāi fá le ma？”
pages.en: “Aren’t you going to punish Rahim?” asks little brother.

pages.zh: 妈妈警告说：“拉希姆，你很快就会后悔的。”
pages.pinyin: māmā jǐnggào shuō：“lā xī mǔ， nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì hòuhuǐ de。”
pages.en: “Rahim, soon you will be sorry,” warns mama.

pages.zh: 不久，拉希姆果然开始感到恶心起来。
pages.pinyin: bùjiǔ， lā xī mǔ guǒrán kāishǐ gǎndào ěxīn qǐlái。
pages.en: Rahim starts to feel sick.

pages.zh: 拉希姆小声说：“我肚子很疼。”
pages.pinyin: lā xī mǔ xiǎo shēng shuō：“wǒ dǔzi hěn téng。”
pages.en: “My tummy is so sore,” whispers Rahim.

pages.zh: 妈妈早料到会发生这样的事情。拉希姆受到了水果的惩罚！
pages.pinyin: māmā zǎo liào dàohuì fāshēng zhèyàng de shìqíng。 lā xī mǔ shòudào le shuǐguǒ de chéngfá！
pages.en: Mama knew this would happen. The fruit is punishing Rahim!

pages.zh: 后来，拉希姆跟我们道歉说：“以后我再也不会贪吃了。”而我们这次都相信他！
pages.pinyin: hòulái， lā xī mǔ gēn wǒmen dàoqiàn shuō：“yǐhòu wǒ zài yě búhuì tān chī le。” ér wǒmen zhècì dōu xiāngxìn tā！
pages.en:
Later, Rahim says sorry to us. “I will never be so greedy again,” he promises.
And we all believe him.
